title: Systems Engineer
body:
Apply Now Description Lead Systems Engineer – Agile Team Systems Engineering Leidos is seeking Lead Systems Engineers to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of next-generation flight service and air traffic systems. This work aligns with the FAA’s broader initiative to modernize legacy flight service capabilities, replacing aging infrastructure with scalable, cloud-based platforms designed to improve safety and operational efficiency—particularly in remote and high-dependency aviation environments. These efforts focus on delivering mission-critical, future-ready solutions that provide safety-critical flight services to the pilot community. 
 As a member of a Scaled Agile software development organization, you will contribute to the technical execution of a program that integrates proven, globally deployed technologies with modern cloud-native capabilities. You will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to deliver predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment. 
 In this position, you will serve as the dedicated Systems Engineer for an Agile/SAFe development team, partnering closely with Product Owners, architects, software engineers, testers, DevSecOps engineers, and customer stakeholders to define, refine, and validate system capabilities. You will ensure that operational needs, regulatory requirements, and system-level behaviors are fully understood, traceable, testable, and aligned to program objectives throughout the development lifecycle. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation. 
 Primary Responsibilities Review FAA requirement documents, advisory circulars, and applicable regulations (e.g., 14 CFR parts) to extract intent, constraints, interfaces, and acceptance criteria. Translate operational and regulatory requirements into detailed, testable system requirements, features, and acceptance criteria that support Agile development activities. Collaborate with Product Owners and development teams to refine backlog items, clarify system behaviors, and ensure technical completeness and traceability. Engage with customer stakeholders, operators, and subject matter experts to identify use cases with an emphasis on completeness, testability, alignment with operational workflows, and readiness for validation trials. Decompose high-level regulatory and operational requirements into specific capability statements with measurable performance criteria and traceability to FAA compliance outcomes. Develop and maintain requirements traceability between stakeholder needs, system requirements, architecture artifacts, implementation tasks, and verification activities. Experience administering GitLab repositories, merge requests, branching strategies, repository permissions, and source code management workflows. Experience developing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or similar technologies. Experience deploying containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) using Helm or comparable tools. Experience developing automation using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages. Familiarity with Linux administration and command-line tools. Experience with AWS cloud services supporting modern application deployments. Knowledge of software supply chain security, secrets management, dependency management, and secure software development practices. title: Test Engineer
body:
Apply Now Description Leidos is seeking a Test Engineer to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of the Leidos Common Automation Platform (L-CAP). L-CAP is a mission-critical, future-ready automation platform built on a hybrid cloud data mesh architecture, enabling next-generation air traffic management capabilities. We are building with an AI-first engineering mindset, embracing emerging AI capabilities and modern development practices to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and continuously evolve how we design and build mission-critical systems. This role operates within a SAFe/Agile framework as part of an Agile Release Train (ART) delivering iterative value across the program. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation.  
 This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days working from home, i f you are located within a commutable distance (Less than 1 hour's drive one-way during normal traffic) from Gaithersburg, MD; Eagan, MN; or Egg Harbor Township, NJ. However, if you do not reside within a commutable distance, you may be considered for a 100% remote role.  
 What You’ll Do  Design and implement test automation frameworks for microservices-based platform components  Build and maintain reusable test libraries and utilities for the L-CAP test infrastructure  Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines ensuring continuous quality gates  Conduct performance testing to validate system behavior under load and stress conditions  Execute integration testing across platform services, APIs, and external system interfaces  Develop test plans and strategies aligned with sprint and PI objectives  Analyze defect patterns and test metrics to identify quality trends and improvement opportunities  Collaborate with development and systems engineering teams on testability and quality requirements  Support test environment configuration and test data management activities  Mentor junior test engineers on automation practices and testing methodologies  Design and execute test scenarios based on operational ATC workflows ensuring modernized services replicate legacy system behavior  Develop distributed service validation frameworks verifying inter-service communication, data flow, and performance under operational conditions  Implement data-driven verification approaches supporting modernization of legacy automation functions  Embrace an AI-first engineering culture by actively adopting AI-assisted development tools, automation, and modern engineering practices that improve productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity.  
 Core Technical Qualifications:  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline with 3+ years of experience, or Master’s degree with 2+ years (additional experience, education and training may be considered in lieu of degree) Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, JUnit, pytest, or equivalent) and Java or JavaScript test development Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar tools Experience with performance, integration, and API testing for distributed systems using tools such as JMeter or Gatling Knowledge of distributed service testing , including service virtualization, contract testing, chaos engineering, and data-driven test automation Experience with operational scenario-based testing, behavioral validation, root cause analysis, and defect investigation Familiarity with Agile/SAFe testing, quality engineering principles, test management, and defect tracking tools Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust U.S. citizenship required Successful completion of background investigations as required by the government customer 
 Preferred / Desired Qualifications:  Python scripting and test development proficiency  Experience testing microservices and event-driven architectures  Knowledge of containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes)  Experience with API testing frameworks (REST Assured, Postman/Newman)  Familiarity with security testing tools and practices  Experience in aviation, defense, or safety-critical testing domains  Knowledge of test-driven development (TDD) and behavior-driven development (BDD)  Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, automated testing, intelligent debugging)  Experience testing legacy-to-modern migration verifying functional equivalence between old and new systems  
 Why Leidos?   
 You’ll work on systems where performance, precision, and reliability matter — every second. This is not experimental AI for prototypes. This is disciplined, responsible AI applied to mission-critical software that supports national infrastructure. If you’re excited by solving complex problems in regulated, real-world environments — and using AI as a force multiplier rather than a shortcut — we’d like to talk.

Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD tooling , such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins. Working knowledge of NIST 800-53 , automated security evidence, and AWS or Azure cloud security . Understanding of network security , including segmentation and default-deny policies. U.S. citizenship required , with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust and meet government background investigation requirements. Experience securing Kubernetes/OpenShift environments , including service mesh security (Istio, Linkerd) and security context constraints. title: Part-Time Legal Assistant
body:
Seeking a (part-time) LEGAL ASSISTANT to help me with my solo law business located in Bloomington, Minnesota. I am looking for a person with some law firm experience who would be willing to work about half-time for the balance of the year. Later in the year there may be an opportunity for full-time employment if desired. Our firm currently has a primary focus on estate planning, probate, and real estate. We also handle uncontested family law matters and help small business owners establish their businesses. If you possess the necessary qualifications, can handle credit card payments, invoices, management practice software (Clio) and preparation of beautiful legal documents, are interested in being considered for this position, please send me your cover letter and resume.
Hours: Monday – Friday/9:00 a.m. – 1:30 p.m.(1/2 hour for lunch)
Compensation: $30 per hour.
Requirements: My number one requirement for the position is dependability and willingness to “show up” for work each and every day. If your attendance has not been excellent in your prior positions, please don’t bother to apply. I am too old to be a babysitter. Another attribute I would really appreciate is someone who likes to learn how to do things by watching tutorials and taking advantage of the many learning tools that are available these days for learning how to use Clio and other software systems (that older attorneys are typically not very good at!).
General qualifications, skills and abilities:
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Adobe, Dropbox, QuickBooks, CLIO or similar CRMs
Ability to prepare invoices, process and track payments and prioritize and work efficiently
Deadline and detail-oriented
Ability to take direction
Professional demeanor
Courteous and friendly
Willing to make telephone calls to previous and prospective clients and referral sources
Ability to work independently
Note: Some expertise in social media and e-marketing would be a bonus.
General responsibilities:
Utilize templates for drafting wills, trusts and other estate planning documents
Prepare and record deeds with appropriate counties in Minnesota
Communicate with clients, attorneys and referral sources
E-file documents with Minnesota courts
Assist attorney with creating detailed policies and procedures and complete “playbook”
Detailing each step undertaken for all projects and cases
Assist with execution of legal documents by clients
Processing credit card payments, assistance with preliminary collection of expenses and income monthly for submission to bookkeeper.
* Principals only. Recruiters, please don't contact this job poster.

title: Independent Living Skills Overnight (Awake)
body:
Apply Now SpringPath Mental Health Services, a part of the Sevita family, provides behavioral health services through Intensive Residential Treatment, Assertive Community Treatment, and Targeted Case Management programs. We embrace a person-centered approach that is trauma informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-oriented. Our dedicated team supports individuals with mental health, psychiatric, or other complex needs to overcome challenges, build skills, and live a full, meaningful life. 
 SUMMARY 
 The ILS Overnight Coach works as part of an Intensive Residential Treatment Services team that provides care, treatment and rehabilitation for persons served who are experiencing significant mental health/psychiatric symptoms; who are demonstrating significant functional impairments; and who may have co-occurring disorders. This is an awake position.   
 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.   
 Provide assistance to person(s) served in order to promote their physical, social, and psychological well-being. 
 Interact frequently and positively with person(s) served and support staff to promote the rights of the person(s) served to achieve an enhanced quality of life. 
 Assist Psychiatric Rehabilitation Practitioners with requested needs. 
 Follow agency procedures to promote optimum health care, safety practice and behavioral supports to maintain the well-being of person(s) served. 
 Administrative duties (scanning, faxing, organizing). 
 Oversee meal preparation in the morning. 
 Cleaning tasks; including preparing a room for new admissions. 
 Transportation for people served. 
 Provide group and individual services for clients. 
 Teach clients independent living skills. 
 Develop and maintain a cooperative working relationship with various teams. 
 Provide the necessary financial management for the day-to-day operations of the program using established practices and procedures. 
 Ensure compliance with training licensing regulations and company policies and procedures. 
 Medication Administration and monitoring. 
 Maintain clean and safe work environment; provide overnight duties from cleaning checklist. 
 Adhere to the practice of maintaining a therapeutic environment including the prevention of crisis at the lowest level of escalation. 
 Develop and participate in community and in-house recreational and leisure activities, as conducive to schedule. 
 Complete all documentation as required to ensure quality services. 
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 None 
 Minimum Knowledge and Skills required for the Job 
 The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job. 
 Education and Experience:  
 GED or High School Diploma with 2,000 supervised hours in the delivery of services to adults with serious mental illness. 
 Bachelor's degree preferred in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college or university. 
 Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations: 
 N/A. 
 Other Skills and Abilities: 
 N/A.
 Other Requirements: 
 Travel as needed. 
 Physical Requirements: 
 Medium Work: Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. 
 Pay Rate: $21-22 
 Sevita is a leading provider of home and community-based specialized health care. We believe that everyone deserves to live a full, more independent life. We provide people with quality services and individualized supports that lead to growth and independence, regardless of the physical, intellectual, or behavioral challenges they face. 
We’ve made this our mission for more than 50 years. And today, our 40,000 team members continue to innovate and enhance care for the 50,000 individuals we serve all over the U.S. 
 As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.  Fuel your Purpose. Make an Impact.

Joyful Companions Home Care is a family-owned Christian-based business, providing non-medical caregiver services to seniors and older adults with disabilities. We strive to help our clients live independently for as long as possible, while also bringing peace of mind to their families. Joyful Companions provides care through a variety of tasks, including light housekeeping, grocery shopping, meal preparation, laundry, and transportation.

 Develop Treatment Plans that are clinically sound and engaging

title: Private Duty RN/LPN
body:
Weekend evenings/overnight coverage NEEDED IMMEDIATELY for Private Duty Nursing Position in West Lakeland Township (between Lake Elmo and Bayport) weekend one. In Scandia, off northeast side of Big Marine Lake on weekend two. This client has 24/7 nursing scheduled. Nursing students welcome – will train.
Client is a 29 year old male who is non-ambulatory, but mobile in his electric wheel chair daily. He is 75 lbs. and about 40 inches tall. Is a one-person transfer. Meds consist of one sub-cut injection a day. He is happy and alert and goes out in community for walks, shopping, train shows, etc. Client is on a Trilogy ventilator with a uncuffed trach (is off vent 7 hours/daily). Client is very stable making it a good situation for nurses to learn ventilator and suctioning skills. G-tube for hydration/meds only. Consumes meals orally. No disposable pants, toilets and lets you know when needed. Does some self-occupation. He can do some communication.
This is a pleasant position in a great environment with a good team of helpful skilled nurses.
Skills needed, but will train: Ventilator, trach, G-tube, transfers, injections.
Benefits include: Paid time off and FMLA paid leave. 401K plan. Holiday pay on shifts worked. Free CEUs at Rochester Community Technical College. Lit close parking.
Hourly Pay: RNs 39/41, LPNs 30/32 (shift differential for overnights)
REQUIRED:
Nursing License: currently registered on MN Board of Nursing website in good standing
Passing background study
Can legally work in the USA
Driver’s License/reliable transportation
Committed and reliable for shifts scheduled
Works well with the team of skilled nurses and family
CPR or BLS certificate
Two step or Gold standard TB test (or X-Ray) completed or in process
Can read, write and speak English
Can transfer 75 lbs without restrictions

body:

title: PCA position! Overnights and early mornings. Swimming and bonuses!
body:
*** Are you an active individual seeking an active yet relaxing job?*** Do you enjoy helping others lead full and productive lives through physical fitness and recreation, specifically swimming? ***An adult male with cerebral palsy is seeking direct support staff. Client is responsible for hiring, training and supervision of staff. Staff must have current valid drivers license and be both willing and able to frequently transport client using client's personal vehicle with no restrictions and have the ability to pass a mandated background check . Applicants should be comfortable assisting with activities of daily living, including but not limited to, the following: Standing pivot and hoyer lift transfers, dressing, grooming, bathing and meal preparation, as well as assistance in the community, including regular assistance with one on one swimming. 
 This is a full-time position.(40 hrs per week). Exact hours and schedule are negotiable. There is a 12.5% enhanced pay rate as the client now qualifies for the State of Minnesota PCA enhanced pay rate subsidy for all staffCandidates must be punctual, good communicators and be able to manage child care and other responsibilities in a way that they do not frequently interfere with a regularly set schedule. In need of overnights and early mornings as well as weekend day shifts. Also willing to consider part-time weekends only shifts. Must be able to transport client in client's vehicle, be comfortable assisting client in swimming and other recreational activities and work related activities. Bonuses for ,performance and availability
Would prefer full-time staff however am willing to consider part-time and multiple shifts if we are found to be a good match.
This position is ideal for someone who is committed and enjoys travel; the ideal staff is active and athletic, enjoys various forms of recreation and is comfortable in the water, as you will be expected to assist the client swimming one-on-one frequently. Staff also should enjoy work in a variety of settings, both professional and social, and be committed to helping people with important aspects of their independence. Punctuality, preperation and communication are a must in this position 
Previous direct care experience is not required, though it is preferred, especially with standing pivot transfers. Please note any experience you would consider relevant when applying, especially experience assisting clients in travel and in 1-1 swimming. Be as detailed as possible in describing your preferred schedule, experience (comfort in the water)and availability)Include any and all duties,details on the types clients worked for or with, as well as any personal attributes or interests you feel make you the ideal candidate for this position.

 Our crisis homes provide support and supervision to person's served with disabilities and/or mental illness that need crisis intervention services and/or behavioral programs to rehabilitate/ stabilize,  and transition  persons  served back to permanent housing.   
 Staff are  required  have 3 years  of  experience working with individuals with the following: severe mental illness, crisis, physical interventions, and behavior  supports .  Implement formal/informal crisis plans, program  plans  and/or behavioral  objectives  using person-centered planning.   
 Maintain documentation, record  keeping  and  participate  in regular  meetings  and complete required training.   
 Take initiative when responding to a crisis,  monitor  the safety of persons served, and  provide  support and supervision in a positive therapeutic manner with the least restrictive methods of positive intervention.

title: ILS Med Room Support
body:
Apply Now SpringPath Mental Health Services, a part of the Sevita family, provides behavioral health services through Intensive Residential Treatment, Assertive Community Treatment, and Targeted Case Management programs. We embrace a person-centered approach that is trauma informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-oriented. Our dedicated team supports individuals with mental health, psychiatric, or other complex needs to overcome challenges, build skills, and live a full, meaningful life. 
 SUMMARY 
 The ILS Med Room Support works as part of an Intensive Residential Treatment Services team that provides care, treatment and rehabilitation for persons served who are experiencing significant mental health/psychiatric symptoms; who are demonstrating significant functional impairments; and who may have co-occurring disorders. This position will partner with the nurse by assisting with Med Room tasks. 
 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.   
 Provides assistance to person(s) served in order to promote their physical, social, and psychological well-being. 
 Interacts frequently and positively with person(s) served and support staff to promote the rights of the person(s) served to achieve an enhanced quality of life. 
 Assist Nursing team as well as other team members with providing care in accordance with their treatment plans. 
 Follow agency procedures to promote optimum health care, safety practice and behavioral supports to maintain the well-being of person(s) served. 
 Administrative duties (scanning, faxing, organizing). 
 Transport person served as needed. 
 Provide group and individual services for person served. 
 Teach person served independent living skills. 
 Develop and maintain a cooperative working relationship with teams and outside providers. 
 Provide the necessary financial management for the day-to-day operations of the program using established practices and procedures regarding the operations use of agency funds. 
 Ensure compliance with training, licensing regulations and company policies and procedures. 
 Partnering with the nurse regarding medication administration and monitoring and ensuring required documentation is complete. 
 Maintain clean and safe work environment. 
 Manages the day-to-day therapeutic environment including the prevention of crisis at the lowest level of escalation. 
 Develops and participates in community and in-house recreational and leisure activities. 
 Completes all documentation as required to ensure quality services. 
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 None 
 Minimum Knowledge and Skills required for the Job 
 The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job. 
 Education and Experience:  
 GED or High School Diploma with 2,000 supervised hours in the delivery of services to adults with serious mental illness 
 Bachelor's degree preferred in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college or university 
 Physical Requirements: 
 Heavy work.  Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. 
 Pay Rate: $22-23

title: Direct Support Professional (PT - Days)
body:
Apply Now ResCare Community Living, a part of the Sevita family, provides quality services that empower individuals, enhance independence, and help people live well. Since 1974, we’ve supported individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities to live more independently at home and in their community. With our dedicated team and experienced staff, we provide person-centered services that help people build skills, overcome challenges, and reach their full potential. 
 ResCare Community Living, a part of the Sevita family, provides quality services that empower individuals, enhance independence, and help people live well. Since 1974, we’ve supported individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities to live more independently at home and in their community. With our dedicated team and experienced staff, we provide person-centered services that help people build skills, overcome challenges, and reach their full potential. 
 SUMMARY 
 Position Type: Non-exempt, part-time, hourly role. 
 Pay Rate: $23.00/hour  
 Scope of Role: 
 Responsible for providing direct support within a single program, supporting 1 individual in residential setting. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Deliver support per individual service/program plans, including socialization, health maintenance, medication administration, skill/behavioral development. 
 Assist with daily activities: Personal care, housekeeping, recreational activities, transportation, community integration, shopping, citizenship, and other activities of daily living. 
 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.  
 Services and Supports: 
 Direct Support:  Provides direct support or assistance in accordance with individual service or program plans; assists with socialization and behavioral development, personal care, housekeeping, recreational activities, transportation, community orientation, shopping, financial management, citizenship, and other activities of daily living. 
 Records:  Accurately documents progress and activity; reviews records and logs to stay abreast of changes in service plans; maintains confidentiality. 
 Management of Individuals’ Assets:  Makes cost-effective and appropriate purchases within the budget of the individual served and according to their choice / preference 
 Relationships:  Maintains healthy and professional relationships with individuals, friends, families, guardians and case managers; greets family members and other visitors; implements Sevita Customer Service Standards. 
 Reporting:  Reports any instance of alleged abuse or neglect according to internal and external standards; reports medical, behavioral and other incidents in accordance with Sevita policy and external requirements. 
 Rights:  Maintains confidentiality, respects the rights of persons being served, according to applicable the bill of rights; practices universal precautions; assists individuals in exercising their rights. 
 Health Care: 
 Appointments:  As needed, may accompany individuals to medical appointments; relays orders and information to and from medical providers as required. 
 Medications:  If assigned, accurately administers or supports self-administration of medication and documents delivery of medications and treatments; promptly reports administration errors; maintains appropriate security of controlled medications and other medications and supplies. 
 General Health Care:  Monitors individual’s health; documents health concerns; communicates with nurse or supervisor as appropriate; calls 911 in the event of emergency; follows individual health care directives. 
 Medical Supplies and Equipment:  Correctly follows procedures in utilizing medical equipment; reports malfunction or disrepair. 
 Meal Preparation:  Prepares or supports individuals to prepare food in accordance with planned menus and individual choice; knows special diets and prepares individual meals accordingly; monitors mealtime and correctly implements any dining plans. 
 Employment Responsibilities: 
 Training:  Attends orientation and on-going training as directed; participates in monthly staff meetings. 
 Employee Scheduling:  Works scheduled hours; arrives for work on time; stays on shift until replacement arrives; notifies supervisor in advance when unable to work as scheduled or as soon as possible after the designated start time; may fill in for other shifts where required without causing unapproved overtime, or in the event of emergency. 
 Teamwork:  Works together with others, values others contributions; is courteous; communicates openly; listens; and shows respect to others. 
 Workplace Safety:  Every employee plays a role in developing and maintaining a safe workplace; complies with all established safety policies, procedures, and rules; reports unsafe hazards to their supervisor and participates in safety related training or activities. 
 Maintenance: 
 Vehicles:  May transport individuals into the community; drives safely and according to local laws; ensures proper use of safety equipment including seat belts, lifts and wheelchair ties; reports accidents to appropriate authorities immediately; reports accidents and safety concerns immediately to supervisor or maintenance personnel. 
 Housekeeping:  Performs daily and seasonal housekeeping as directed; maintains neat, clean and safe environment; reports hazards or safety concerns. 
 Maintenance and Repair:  Monitors environmental safety and may make minor repairs, change light bulbs, etc.; may perform yard maintenance including keeping walkways safe and snow removal; reports equipment or facilities requiring repairs to supervisor or maintenance personnel as required. 
 Safety:  Checks water temperature as required when assisting with bathing; participates in safety drills and protects persons being served in the event of emergency. 
 Other: 
 Performs other duties and activities as required. 
 MPA = Mobile Punch Authorized for timekeeping. 
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 None 
 Minimum Knowledge and Skills required for the Job 
 The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job. 
 Education and Experience:  
 High school diploma or equivalent preferred 
 Must be 18 years of age. 
 Working knowledge of computers 
 DSP3 Experience Requirements: 
 Our crisis homes provide support and supervision to person's served with disabilities and/or mental illness that need crisis intervention services and/or behavioral programs to rehabilitate/stabilize, and transition persons served back to permanent housing. 
 Staff are required have 3 years of experience working with individuals with the following: severe mental illness, crisis, physical interventions, and behavior supports. Including challenging behaviors of property destruction, manipulation, inaccurate reporting, elopement, paranoia, substance abuse, isolation and/or self-injury. 
 Staff must be well trained and have at least 3 years of experience in using positive redirection and behavior modification programs. Working with individuals with mental health conditions including bipolar, schizophrenia, depression, anxiety, PTSD, substance use disorders, obsessive compulsive disorder, intermittent explosive disorder, antisocial personality disorders, etc. 
 Apply Now

This is an awake position.

 Medication Administration and monitoring.

 Adhere to the practice of maintaining a therapeutic environment including the prevention of crisis at the lowest level of escalation. 
 Develop and participate in community and in-house recreational and leisure activities, as conducive to schedule. 
 Complete all documentation as required to ensure quality services.

body:
APPLY HERE: https://jobs.augusta.care/apply/seniors-helping-seniors-minneapolis-mn?channel_source=Craigslist 
Seniors Helping Seniors® in-home care services offers companionship for seniors who wish to remain active and independent from the comfort of home. We’re looking to add to our team of caregivers and are searching for mature and compassionate individuals to assist seniors in the community.
Our team believes that seniors can help each other age with dignity, grace, and respect. One of the most important aspects of our services is providing companionship to those we serve. To do so, we commit to pairing caregivers with care receivers who share similar interests and backgrounds. This ensures a mutually beneficial relationship that helps to encourage a deep and meaningful connection.
Seniors Helping Seniors® caregivers also help with daily tasks like light house cleaning, yardwork, medication reminders, and transportation to and from appointments or social events. Additionally, we offer respite care and 24/7 support for those with more advanced needs, as well as specialized assistance for individuals with Alzheimer’s and Dementia.
What do we look for in a caregiver?
We don’t require our senior caregivers to possess a particular level of experience, just a passion for helping seniors in the community continue to live independently. Most of our caregivers are active seniors themselves.
Our caregivers should encompass the following traits:
• Can relate to the aging process, helping those we serve navigate the challenges that growing older can bring
• Enjoys helping others
• Compassionate and empathetic to the needs of the senior community
• Willing to share life stories, interests, and hobbies with a senior companion
Why join Seniors Helping Seniors® in-home care services?
We’ve found that our caregivers benefit just as much as those we serve through their work with Seniors Helping Seniors® in-home services. This position offers a rewarding experience and the chance to foster a true friendship with an active senior, all while earning extra income. You’ll also appreciate a flexible schedule, designed to accommodate your needs.

We spend time getting to know potential caregivers throughout the interview process. It’s important that we get a feel for your background, interests, and hobbies so that we can pair you with a senior who can relate. body:

• tuition reimbursement and professional development training

title: Draftsman Wanted
body:
Job Title: Residential Designer / Project Administrator
Company: Dodge Brothers Construction
Location: Amery, WI
Position Type: Full-Time 
About Us:
Dodge Brothers Construction is a premier residential builder based in Amery, Wisconsin. We specialize in high-quality home construction and remodels, taking pride in our precise field execution, strong structural standards, and professional team culture. We are looking for a reliable, multi-talented professional to manage our design pipeline and keep our daily office operations running smoothly and efficiently. 
Position Overview:
This is a dynamic, hybrid role designed for someone who thrives on variety and organization. You will spend your time split between architectural drafting and essential office administration. The ideal candidate is highly organized, punctual, and possesses a strong understanding of residential construction alongside excellent administrative habits. 
Core Responsibilities:
• Drafting & Design: Produce clear, accurate residential construction document sets—including floor plans, elevations, section details, and framing layouts—using standard design software. 
• Field Verification: Visit job sites in the Amery area to measure existing structures, document conditions, and verify structural dimensions before finalized drawings are issued. 
• Office & Project Administration: Maintain company file systems, organize project submittals, track change orders, coordinate with material suppliers, and handle incoming client communications. 
• Workflow Optimization: Keep project timelines organized, assist with material takeoffs, and proactively verify design or scheduling assumptions with ownership to keep projects moving seamlessly. 
Required Qualifications: 
• Experience: 2–5+ years of experience in residential drafting or construction design. Experience in a construction office setting is a major plus. 
• Technical Skills: Proficiency in residential design software (such as Chief Architect, AutoCAD, or similar) and standard office programs (Microsoft Office / Google Workspace). 
• Industry Knowledge: Solid understanding of residential framing, standard lumber dimensions, building materials, and Wisconsin residential building codes. 
• Key Attributes: Exceptional attention to detail, proactive organizational habits, strong time-management skills, and a reliable track record of daily punctuality. 
What We Offer: 
• Competitive hourly wage based on experience. 
• A steady, reliable, and professional year-round indoor office environment. 
• A structured and supportive team where clear communication is valued. 
To Apply:
Please submit your resume, examples of residential construction plans you have drafted, and a brief note explaining why you are the right fit for this hybrid role to.

title: Product Tester & Technician for Video Game Consoles JOB M-F 7am-4pm
body:
At Loot Hive, we're on a mission to give used video game consoles such as the Nintendo Wii, Xbox 360, and PlayStation 2 a second chance at life. Our team is dedicated to restoring, testing, and getting these consoles back into the hands of gamers who cherish them. Join us and be part of a team that's passionate about gaming history and committed to quality.
Position Overview:
If you've got a knack for bringing consumer electronic products back to life, you're just the person we need. We're on the hunt for a Product Tester and Technician who can work both individually and with others to join our team. Previous professional technician experience is not required, and we'll provide training on our specific testing and repair processes. However, we're looking for candidates who already have a demonstrated interest or aptitude in electronics, video game hardware, repair, troubleshooting, or other hands-on technical work.
Schedule & Location:
Monday through Friday day shifts only because we don't like working nights or weekends!
Choose an 8-hour shift that fits your schedule: between 7 AM-4 PM
Convenient Bloomington location near Hwy 494 and 35W
Responsibilities:
-Test, troubleshoot, clean and grade products to prepare them for sale
-Perform simple repairs and part swaps - Will train as needed
-Provide counts, put units into storage, and other basic inventory tasks
-Operate tools including screwdrivers, power drivers, soldering irons (will train), cleaning brushes, and canned air
-Work mainly with Video Game Consoles, but also Mobile Phones, Handheld GPS, Home Audio, Car Audio products and more
Requirements:
-Basic familiarity with consumer electronics, video game hardware, or other technical/mechanical equipment
-Interest and aptitude for troubleshooting, testing, and learning how electronic products work
-Comfortable working with your hands and using basic tools on a daily basis
-Strong attention to detail and ability to follow testing and repair procedures
-Team player with solid communication skills
-Reliably commute or planning to relocate to Bloomington, MN 55420 before starting work
-Preferred Qualifications:
Professional experience is not required, but any of the following is a plus:
-Personal, school, or work experience repairing, troubleshooting, modifying, or taking apart electronics
-Familiarity with video game consoles, controllers, PCs, mobile devices, audio equipment, or similar electronics
-Experience using hand tools, power tools, soldering equipment, or electronic testing tools
-PC building, console repair/modding, electronics projects, IT/hardware support, automotive/mechanical work, or similar hands-on technical hobbies
-Previous experience in electronics testing, refurbishment, repair, manufacturing, or quality control
Attributes That Will Help You Thrive:
-Genuine interest in electronics, gaming hardware, repair, or learning how devices work
-A curious, troubleshooting-oriented mindset and enjoyment of figuring out why something isn't working
-A keen eye for detail and willingness to learn
What's In It For You:
-Opportunities to grow and learn in a supportive work environment
-Be part of a team that values your contributions and believes in the importance of preserving gaming history
Benefits:
-Paid time off
-Paid Holidays off
-Generous employee discount
-Individual Retirement Account (IRA) with company match (100% up to 3%)
Bonus Perks:
-Work while listening to your own music
-Free monthly lunch provided by the company
How to Apply:
-SEND YOUR RESUME by EMAIL (REPLY to this post)
-Add a short note telling us about your interest or experience with electronics, video game hardware, troubleshooting, repair, PC building, or other hands-on technical work.
-Professional experience isn't required - personal projects and hobbies count too!
-We'll be in touch with the candidates who are ready to roll up their sleeves and join us in the mission to revive gaming classics.
Please note that we are unable to offer sponsorship for work visas or relocation. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship from Loot Hive. We appreciate your understanding in this matter.

title: Warehouse Associates / Reach Truck Forklift Operators - Hiring Now!
body:
Position Summary 
We are seeking dependable and safety-focused Warehouse Associates and Reach Truck Forklift Operators to support warehouse operations at a high-volume facility in Eagan, MN. 
Warehouse Associates will focus on packing, labeling, quality checks, pallet handling, and general warehouse support. Reach Truck Forklift Operators will focus on the safe and efficient movement of materials throughout the facility, loading and unloading trucks, picking orders, and staging materials using a reach truck (sit-down) forklift. 
Warehouse Associate – Key Responsibilities: 
* Pack and repack products according to customer specifications, including taping, labeling, and palletizing. 
* Inspect products for quality, condition, and accurate labeling before shipment. 
* Assist with pallet projects, case picking, stretch wrapping, and other warehouse assignments. 
* Verify pick sheets, outbound shipments, and inbound pallets for accuracy. 
* Move and count pallets to support inventory and warehouse organization. 
* Operate a forklift as assigned and assist with general warehouse duties. 
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area. 
Reach Truck Forklift Operator – Key Responsibilities: 
* Safely operate sit-down forklifts and reach trucks to move, load, unload, pick, and stage materials. 
* Move and stack palletized or crated materials in designated storage locations. 
* Pick, check, and load products to and from designated areas and trailers. 
* Use RF scanners and complete required inventory and shipping documentation. 
* Perform equipment inspections and report safety, quality, or maintenance concerns. 
* Follow OSHA and PPE requirements while maintaining a clean and safe work environment. 
Requirements: 
* High school diploma, GED, or equivalent preferred. 
* Warehouse Associate - At least 1 year of warehouse experience preferred. 
* Forklift: At least 1 year of sit-down forklift experience and reach truck experience required. 
* RF scanner experience preferred for Forklift Operators. 
* Basic computer and math skills. 
* Ability to read, write, and speak English proficiently. 
* Strong attention to detail, reliability, and ability to follow work instructions. 
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
* Willingness to cross-train and assist in other warehouse areas as needed. 
* Spanish-speaking skills are highly preferred
* Safety boots/shoes required. 
Physical Requirements: 
* Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. with or without reasonable assistance. 
* Frequent standing, walking, lifting, reaching, bending, stooping, kneeling, and crouching. 
* Ability to perform repetitive tasks and handle products safely.

title: CNC Setup Machinist -- 3- & 4- Axis Vertical Mills
body:
CNC Setup Machinist 
Comet Tool Inc

Compensation: $25-$35/HR
Employment type: full-time
Job title: CNC Setup Machinist - 1st Shift (Mon-Thu 6:00am-3:30pm; Fri 6:00am-10:00am)
Job Description
We are looking for a skilled CNC Setup Machinist to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for setting up and operating 3- & 4-axis CNC vertical milling machines – specifically focusing on our Haas VF-2 through VF-4 series.
While we have a dedicated programmer on staff, we need someone who is fluent in G & M code. You must be able to confidently read, edit, and optimize programs directly at the control panel, identify toolpath errors, and execute complex setups. You will be working with a diverse range of materials, moving daily from standard Aluminum and Stainless Steel to challenging Nickel Alloys, High Temp Alloys, and Titanium.
Key Responsiblilties
• Machine Setup and Operation: Perform complete mechanical setups on Haas VF-2, VF-3 and VF-4 vertical mills, including dialing in fixtures, vices, rotary tables (4th axis), and part probes.
• Collaboration: Partner with our in-house programming department to feedback toolpath enhancements and resolve program bugs quickly.
Qualifications and Experience
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience setting up and operating CNC Vertical Machining Centers (VMCs).
• Machine Fluency: Strong background working directly with Haas controls and the Haas VF product lineup. 4th axis experience is highly preferred.
• Programming Skills: High proficiency in manually reading and editing G & M codes. Full conversational or CAM programming is a plus, but manual optimization at the control panel is required.
• Blueprint reading: Expert ability to read and interpret mechanical blueprints and engineering drawings, including GD&T symbols.
• Material Knowledge: Demonstrated experience managing chip load, heat generation, And tool wear across hard exotics (Titanium, Inconel/Nickel alloys) and soft metals (Aluminum).
Benefits & Compensation
• Pay Range: $25-35 / hour (depending on experience)
• Health, Dental, Short-term and Long-term disability and Life
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays
• Safe, clean, and climate-controlled shop environment

FUNCTION: To provide INTEGRITY and QUALITY CONTROL by consistently delivering superior fabrication and manufacturing of parts and components with vertical and horizontal milling machines, lathes, drills, saws, welding, and surface grinders while maximizing personal productivity. They will work with a positive attitude, with a spirit of cooperation and occasionally mentor co-workers, some of whom may be apprentices while maximizing personal productivity. S/he will uphold company standards on areas such as work rules and complies with all Company workplace safety programs.
REPORTABILITY: Shop Manager
ACCOUNTABILITY: Shop Manager
DUTIES:
• Run manual lathe to grind rollers to size
• Using measurement tools: Mics, calipers, Pi Tapes, tape measures to verify specs
• Responsible for set-up and run of custom one of a kind and volume quality parts on manual machines with close tolerances in a time definite environment. Environment requires working in carbon, steel, brass, copper, and alloy steels with small and large parts with close tolerances from drawings.
DAILY WORK FUNCTIONS:
1- Run manual lathes to grind rollers to correct size
2- Must be able to read drawings and lay-out work.
3- Records start/stop times on timesheets to account for production time.
4- Provides other supplemental services to the rubber roller production area of the company. 
5- Takes necessary preventative maintenance steps on all equipment, both machine shop and rubber roller production to ensure production machines are at peak performance and reports any irregularities to immediate supervisor. Support secondary manufacturing operations such as Disassembly, stripping, building, grinding, finishing, assembly, or packaging of manufactured product where needed. 
6- Be knowledgeable in quality control in shop machine processes, and quality standards in the use of calipers, micrometer and dial indicators for checking of finished part. Be knowledgeable and remain current with all safety guidelines with regards to facilities and environmental compliance issues. 
7- Acquire technical updates from the Shop Foreman on machines and support equipment as necessary to provide production support, proper repair and maintenance. 
8- Must understand that time-sensitive work orders are to be prioritized and furthermore communicate conditions which compromise on time completion or restrict its production. 
9- Communicate the status of lack of material, out-of-service machines and/or equipment to the Shop supervisor well in advance of each work process for which would ordinarily be needed to complete scope of work. 
10- Maintain accurate time keeping on work orders of all shop and maintenance related work and submit to Shop supervisor as work is completed 
11- Utilizes forklift to load and unload raw product as necessary.
12- Ensures any surplus raw inventory pulls for stock items or assemble are returned to stock and are properly identified. 
13- Observes displays, cutting or machining process, and listens to sound of machines to detect malfunctions. S/he is responsible for the replacement of worn or damaged machine parts.
RISK MANAGEMENT:
Uses established safety practices in physical movement and mechanical lifting of merchandise to protect the health and safety of personnel and property. Machine operator must be able to change work environments/hours as schedule dictates. Slack/Peak demand workloads command time pressure to meet productivity standards. Mandatory overtime will be scheduled on an “as needed” basis. Work scope requires bending, stooping, carrying, climbing, ladders and stairs. Lifting and moving is 45lbs or greater. Job requires exposure to temperature changes and will require experience with operation of fork-lift.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Ability to change work environment at a moment’s notice in order to meet needs of the service for time definite production schedules.
• EDUCATION- high school diploma, GED or VO-TECH degree
• EXPERIENCE- Previous industrial metal manufacturing and 1+ years machining experience.

title: BEOL Equipment Maintenance Technician
body:
As an Equipment Technician, you are responsible for monitoring, sustaining, and improving the equipment and/or processes in the assigned area, while working in partnership with production team members and area engineers. Shift Technicians monitor tool performance, schedule and perform preventative maintenance on assigned tool sets, and use mechanical, electronic and PC/software skills to troubleshoot and repair equipment issues. They are also required to assist with equipment installs; tests; create and modify equipment procedures; and increase tool uptime through systematic problem solving and troubleshooting, quality workmanship, thoroughly document all maintenance performed in established check sheets and tracking programs, and routine review of maintenance check sheets and procedures. They monitor, analyze and address SPC issues for area processes on a daily basis and respond to SPC out of control issues. Shift Technicians are required to keep the Lead Tech and/or Area Engineer updated on tool and area issues.
Job Duties
• Complete all required safety training and conduct all work in accordance with safety policies.
• Troubleshoot, maintain and ensure uptime on all applicable equipment.
• Perform preventive maintenance & repair/calibration on key process equipment & systems.
• Provide content for, and submit updates for controlled documentation (PM procedures, check-sheets, work instructions, etc.)
• Participate on the Emergency Response Team.
• Safely perform work in a hazardous environment utilizing proper Personal Protective Equipment (including SCBA or respirator).
• Engage in systematic troubleshooting to identify root-cause of failures.
• Minimize tool down-time and variability to increase equipment availability.
• Document all maintenance activities in Equipment Management System.
• Monitor, analyze, and address SPC issues.
• Support and maintain 5S activities.
• Communicate issues effectively to the all team members.
• Contribute to and communicate detailed pass downs to ensure a smooth transition from shift-to-shift.
• Partner with Production team members and area engineers to support equipment
Requirements
• Knowledge of electronics and control systems, mechanics / robotics, hydraulics, pneumatics and vacuum systems, heat transfer, fluid mechanics. Skill in diagnosing equipment issues. Verbal and written communication. 
• Requires an Associate’s degree in electronics technology or other relevant curriculum, or a combination of education and substantial directly related experience in semiconductor manufacturing environment.
Main Requirement:
• 5+ years’ maintenance experience on 200mm or 300mm PECVD and RTA equipment. Equipment includes Novellus C1, LAM/NOVELLUS C2 (Sequel, Speed, Altus), LAM/NOVELLUS (Vector, Extreme), AMAT CVD HDP, AMAT PRODUCER, AMAT RTP, and RTA.
• Understanding of PECVD processes.
• Knowledge of SPC.
• Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude.
SHIFT:
Shift: 5:45 pm – 6:15 am Sunday, Monday, Tuesday and every other Wednesday

body:

Waterproofing Northeast is hiring a dependable crew member who can drive our company box truck and dump truck from day one and work alongside the crew on waterproofing projects.

title: Warehouse & Logistics Coordinator
body:
Primary Impact
Evolving Solutions is a leading technology solutions provider that helps clients modernize and automate their mission-critical applications and infrastructure to support business transformation. Our business is client-centric consulting and delivery of technical solutions to enable modern operations in a hybrid cloud world. 
We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Warehouse & Logistics Coordinator to support daily warehouse operations with a primary focus on planning, coordinating, and improving company-wide logistics and inventory operations, which includes; fulfillment, pick and pack execution, shipping readiness, inventory accuracy, and NetSuite transaction support. This role will work closely with the Senior Warehouse, Logistics, and Building Operations Specialist and the broader Operations team to improve fulfillment flow, reduce handoffs, and help ensure client shipments move accurately and on time.
Evolving Solution Core Values
* Do the Right Thing: Do what is right every day. Your personal integrity and the reputation of Evolving Solutions depends on this.
* Be a Team Player: Evolving Solutions is better when everyone is together. The ability to solve problems as a team for our clients and partners is Evolving Solutions’ strength and differentiation.
* Be Humbly Confident: Possess knowledge and experience to deliver at the highest level, while maintaining the willingness to learn more and the humility to recognize you will never know it all.
Accountability
* Support the pick, pack, and ship process for client orders, including staging, labeling, packaging, and shipment preparation
* Create and process item fulfillments and related warehouse transactions in NetSuite 
* Receive, inspect, organize, and help process inbound shipments, including entering receiving activity in NetSuite as assigned
* Assist with carrier coordination, shipment documentation, delivery preparation, and time-sensitive outbound shipment needs
* Provide backup coverage for critical warehouse functions including receiving, fulfillment, inventory movement, and forklift support 
* Analyze warehouse and logistics metrics 
* Analyze expected client shipment schedules and develop inventory storage and movement plans to optimize warehouse space, maintain fulfillment readiness, and ensure inventory records remain accurate within NetSuite
* Exercise independent judgment regarding inventory placement, internal inventory transfers, shipment prioritization, and operational problem resolution to support efficient warehouse operations and client delivery commitments
* Partner with the Senior Warehouse, Logistics, and Building Operations Specialist on warehouse priorities, process improvements, safety, organization, and workload planning
* Support facilities-related tasks as needed
* Identify and recommend process improvements that enhance client experience, efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
* Other duties as assigned
Qualifications: 
Required
* Minimum of 3 years of warehouse, logistics, inventory, shipping, receiving, or distribution experience
* Experience using an ERP, inventory, warehouse management, or shipping system; NetSuite experience preferred
* Forklift certification or willingness to obtain a certification
Preferred:
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to prioritize time-sensitive shipping needs while maintaining accuracy and organization
* A process improvement mindset with confidence to suggest practical ways to improve workflow, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Ability to build positive working relationships across clients, vendors, carriers and other departments
* Comfort working independently while staying aligned with team priorities, deadlines, and client commitments
* Strong attention to detail with a drive to complete accurate fulfillment, receiving, and inventory work
How to apply:
* Qualified applicants should visit https://evolvingsol.com/about-us/careers/ and complete the online application for consideration. Applications submitted outside of our Careers page will not be considered. 
Work location:
* Onsite 5 days a week at Evolving Solutions Corporate Office, Hamel, Minnesota
Reporting Relationships:
* Reports to Director of Revenue Operations
* Works closely with the Senior Warehouse, Logistics, and Building Operations Specialist
Compensation Range: $40,500 - $57,000 annually
 Evolving Solutions is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Construction General Laborer
body:
GENERAL LABORER
Diversified Construction – St. Louis Park, Minnesota
Diversified Construction is seeking a dependable, hardworking General Laborer to support our commercial construction projects throughout the Twin Cities area.
This is a hands-on, varied position for someone who enjoys working in construction and is willing to jump in wherever needed. Our General Laborers work closely with our Project Superintendents and help keep projects moving by taking care of the many tasks that come up on an active construction site.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
· Jobsite cleanup and maintaining a clean, safe and organized work environment
· Light demolition and removal of construction debris
· Installation and adjustment of door hardware and other miscellaneous building components
· Moving, loading and unloading materials, tools and equipment
· Picking up and delivering materials, parts and supplies to jobsites
· Assisting with protection of existing finishes and preparation of work areas
· Performing minor repairs, punch-list items and miscellaneous construction tasks
· Assisting Superintendents and subcontractors as needed
· Helping prepare jobsites for inspections, owner walkthroughs and project turnover
· General maintenance and organization of jobsites
· Performing other construction-related duties as assigned by the Project Superintendent
Simply put: this position helps take care of whatever needs to be done to keep the job moving.
Qualifications
· Dependable and able to report to work on time
· Strong work ethic and willingness to take direction
· Comfortable working independently or as part of a team
· Basic knowledge of hand and power tools preferred
· Construction experience is helpful, but we are willing to consider candidates with the right attitude and willingness to learn
· Ability to perform physical construction work, including lifting and carrying materials and working on your feet throughout the day
· Ability to work safely and follow jobsite safety requirements
· Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
· Professional and respectful when working around customers, subcontractors and other employees
What We Offer
Diversified Construction offers competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package, including:
· Health and dental insurance
· Disability insurance
· Flexible benefits plan
· Life insurance
· 401(k) with employer contributions
· Paid holidays
· Paid vacation
· Company-sponsored events
· A supportive, team-oriented work environment
About Diversified Construction
Diversified Construction is a St. Louis Park-based commercial general contractor serving businesses throughout the Twin Cities. For more than 60 years, we’ve built our reputation on quality work, professionalism and long-lasting relationships with our clients, employees and trade partners.
We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, is willing to pitch in, and understands that on a construction site no task is too small when it helps get the job done.
Diversified Construction is an equal opportunity employer.
Please send resume, or a list of recent employers with your job description, as well as salary requirements.

Job description:
IMMEDIATE HIRING: Interstate Traveling Kitchen Hood Technician with Paid Training
Full-Time | Paid Training in Minnesota | Interstate Road Work
READ CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING — TRAINING IS IN MINNESOTA, BUT THE JOB IS ON THE ROAD!
D&V Pro Cleaning is hiring full-time Traveling Kitchen Hood Technicians for immediate paid training at our Minnesota location, followed by interstate road work across multiple states.
IMPORTANT: Training takes place in Minnesota. The actual job is NOT based in Minnesota. Once trained and assigned to road work, you will travel from state to state to service commercial kitchens throughout our service areas. This position requires overnight work, hotel stays, and spending 4-6 weeks at time on the road.
This is NOT a local job. You will NOT return home every night. Interstate travel is a required part of the position, not an occasional option.
If you are looking for a local job, only want to work in Minnesota, or cannot commit to extended interstate travel, DO NOT APPLY.
What We Offer
Immediate paid training in Minnesota, no experience needed!
$150 per completed job after training, with earning potential based on workload
Company-covered fuel for work-related travel
Company vehicle provided after training
Company-paid hotels during road assignments
Weekly travel stipend to pay for food and miscellaneous expenses while traveling
Company-provided tools and supplies
Opportunity to grow within the company
About the Role
As a Traveling Kitchen Hood Technician, you will travel across state lines to restaurants and commercial facilities to clean complete kitchen exhaust systems, including hoods, ductwork, exhaust fans, and filters.
You will perform daytime and overnight cleaning jobs, document completed work, and follow applicable NFPA 96 fire safety standards.
Your work location will change as you travel. You must be prepared to leave Minnesota and work in other states for extended periods.

title: Maintenance Technician - 144
body:
SCOPE:
A Maintenance Technician in property management is responsible for performing a variety of repairs and maintenance tasks across residential or commercial properties, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general upkeep, responding to resident/tenant service requests, and ensuring the overall functionality and appearance of the property by completing routine inspections and preventative maintenance procedures, often requiring on-call availability for emergencies; reporting to the property manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintenance Repairs:
*Diagnose and repair plumbing issues like leaky faucets, clogged drains, and toilet malfunctions.
*Troubleshoot and fix electrical problems including faulty outlets, lighting fixtures, and wiring.
*Service HVAC systems, addressing issues with heating, cooling, and air filtration.
*Perform basic carpentry repairs like door and cabinet replacements, drywall patching, and trim work.
*Address appliance malfunctions.
*Conduct minor painting and touch-up work.
Preventative Maintenance:
*Regularly inspect building systems including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and fire safety equipment.

title: EPDM Flat Roofing & Repair Specialist
body:
EPDM Flat Roofing & Repair Specialist
Kaufman Roofing | Twin Cities, MN
Full-Time | $25–$35/hour, based on experience
Kaufman Roofing is looking for an experienced EPDM flat roofing professional who takes pride in craftsmanship, knows how to solve problems, and is looking for a long-term career.
This isn't a large commercial production-roofing position.
Most of our flat roofing work consists of smaller residential roofs, additions, porches, repairs, and detailed low-slope applications. We're looking for someone who understands EPDM and knows that the details around walls, penetrations, transitions, edges and flashing are what make the difference between a roof that simply looks finished and one that stays watertight.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who:
• Has hands-on EPDM installation and repair experience
• Understands membrane installation, seams, flashing, terminations and waterproofing details
• Can diagnose leaks and troubleshoot unusual roof conditions
• Can look at a difficult detail and determine the right way to handle it
• Takes pride in clean, professional workmanship
• Pays attention to the small details
• Is dependable and comfortable working independently when needed
• Communicates professionally with coworkers, project managers and homeowners
• Wants a long-term career, not just another roofing job
Experience with TPO, other roofing systems or sheet metal is a plus, but not required.
What You'll Be Doing
• Installing EPDM rubber roofing systems on residential low-slope and flat roofs
• Completing detailed flashing work around walls, penetrations, transitions, chimneys and other roof details
• Diagnosing and repairing flat-roof leaks
• Handling smaller, detail-oriented projects rather than large commercial production roofs
• Working with our project managers and roofing crews to ensure every project meets Kaufman Roofing's quality standards
• Maintaining a clean, professional and safe jobsite
Pay & Benefits
• $25–$40/hour, based on experience
• Paid Time Off
• Health Insurance
• Dental Insurance
• 401(k)
• Company Phone
• Full-time employment with an established, family-owned company
• A work environment where quality and craftsmanship matter
• Opportunities to grow with the company
About Kaufman Roofing
Kaufman Roofing has been serving Twin Cities homeowners since 1930. We're a local, family-owned roofing company with a reputation built on quality workmanship, customer service and doing things the right way.
Our philosophy is simple: Quality Always. Educate – Not Sell. Details, Details, Details.
If you're an experienced flat roofer who's tired of being just another person on a large production crew and would rather work on projects where your skill, judgment and craftsmanship actually matter, we'd like to talk with you.
Apply today and tell us about your EPDM and flat-roofing experience.

title: Experienced Concrete Pump Operator
body:
The Concrete Pump Operator is a critical role in our construction operations. This position is responsible for operating and maintaining concrete pumps, ensuring safe and efficient handling of concrete at various job sites. As a Concrete Pump Operator, you will work closely with supervisors, fellow crew members, drivers and customers to guarantee that all concrete placement adheres to project specifications, safety regulations, and company standards.
Key Responsibilities
· Safely operate concrete pumps to pour concrete at assigned construction sites
· Set up, clean, and maintain pump equipment and associated hoses and accessories
· Coordinate with site supervisors to ensure proper placement and timing of concrete pours
· Monitor the pump operation, troubleshoot issues, and perform basic repairs and adjustments as needed
· Inspect and maintain the pump truck according to company and regulatory standards
· Ensure all work is completed in accordance with safety protocols and industry guidelines
· Communicate effectively with fellow team members, contractors, and clients
· Document daily activities, including pump log, and any incidents
· Transport pump equipment to and from job sites using company vehicles
· Assist with loading and unloading equipment and supplies as required
· Complete pre- and post-operation inspections and address any mechanical concerns
· Participate in ongoing training and safety meetings
· Maintain cleanliness and organization of equipment, vehicles, and work areas
· Comply with all company policies and procedures
Required Qualifications
· Valid Class B CDL (Commercial Driver’s License) or equivalent, with a clean driving record
· Minimum of 6 months experience operating concrete pump
· Solid understanding of concrete pump operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting
· Strong mechanical aptitude and basic repair skills
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
· Physical ability to lift up to 75 lbs and work in a variety of outdoor conditions
· Keen attention to detail and safety orientation
· Ability to work independently and as part of a team
· Proven reliability, punctuality, and professionalism
Preferred Qualifications
· Familiarity with different types of concrete pumps (boom, line, trailer-mounted, etc.)
· Knowledge of concrete material properties and placement techniques
· Ability to train and mentor entry-level operators
· Fluency in English; multilingual abilities a plus
Compensation and Benefits
We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:
· Hourly wage based on experience and qualifications
· Overtime opportunities
· Health, dental, and life insurance
· 401(k) retirement plan with company match
· Paid time off and holidays
· Supportive work environment with opportunities for advancement
Work Environment and Physical Demands
· Work is performed outdoors at various construction job sites, often in changing weather conditions
· Requires standing, walking, bending, and lifting for extended periods
· Exposure to moving equipment, construction materials, and loud noises
· Strict adherence to safety standards and use of personal protective equipment

title: ALDI - Full-Time Store Associate
body:

As a store associate, you’ll be responsible for merchandising and stocking product, cashiering, and cleaning to keep the store looking its best. You’ll enhance the customer shopping experience by working collaboratively with the ALDI team and providing exceptional customer service.
Position Type: Full-Time
Average Hours: 30+ hours per week

Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Adheres to inventory procedures and product handling guidelines.
• Performs general cleaning tasks to company standards.
Physical Demands:
• Required to push, pull, sit, stand, reach, grasp, twist, bend, and move from one area to another.
• Required to lift, carry, and place product weighing up to 45 pounds on shelves at various heights, including overhead.
• Required to operate equipment such as a cash register, electric and manual hand jacks, floor scrubber and cardboard baler.
• Required to stock product in varying temperatures, including freezer and cooler environments.
• Required to use glass and multipurpose cleaning products.
Qualifications:
• Ability to provide prompt and courteous customer service.
• Ability to operate all store equipment such as cash registers, floor scrubber, cardboard baler, pallet jacks, handheld devices, computers, etc.
• Ability to interpret and apply ALDI operating policies and procedures.
• Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing.
• Ability to perform basic arithmetic such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
• Ability to follow instructions and pay attention to detail.
• Ability to work both independently and with others.
• Ability to organize, prioritize and complete assigned tasks to maximize productivity within established timeframes.
• Ability to maintain reliable and prompt attendance.
• Ability to meet availability requirements.
Education and Experience:
• At least 18 years old required.
• High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
• Prior work experience in a retail environment preferred.

Medical, Prescription, Dental & Vision Insurance

Up to 2 Weeks Paid Caregiver Leave at 100% of pay
Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Life, Dependent Life and AD&D Insurance
Voluntary Term Life Insurance
