title: HIRING NOW! General Labor/Maintenance Tech needed - 155
body:
SCOPE:
A Maintenance Technician in property management is responsible for performing a variety of repairs and maintenance tasks across residential or commercial properties, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general upkeep, responding to resident/tenant service requests, and ensuring the overall functionality and appearance of the property by completing routine inspections and preventative maintenance procedures, often requiring on-call availability for emergencies; reporting to the property manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintenance Repairs:
*Diagnose and repair plumbing issues like leaky faucets, clogged drains, and toilet malfunctions.
*Troubleshoot and fix electrical problems including faulty outlets, lighting fixtures, and wiring.
*Service HVAC systems, addressing issues with heating, cooling, and air filtration.
*Perform basic carpentry repairs like door and cabinet replacements, drywall patching, and trim work.
*Address appliance malfunctions.
*Conduct minor painting and touch-up work.
Preventative Maintenance:
*Regularly inspect building systems including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and fire safety equipment. 
*Perform routine checks on exterior building components like windows, doors, and siding. 
*Maintain landscaping and grounds as needed. 
*Monitor and replace worn-out parts to prevent future breakdowns. 
Resident Service Requests:
*Promptly respond to resident maintenance requests and work orders. 
*Communicate effectively with residents regarding repair status and updates. 
*Prioritize urgent repairs and address emergency situations. 
Administrative Tasks:
*Maintain accurate records of work orders, repairs completed, and parts inventory. 
*Coordinate with contractors for larger projects requiring specialized skills. 
*Adhere to safety protocols and building codes. 
Emergency Repairs:
*May require on-call availability for emergency repairs 
*Vendor Management:
*Coordinate with outside contractors for complex repairs, obtaining quotes and overseeing work completion.
Documentation:
*Maintain detailed records of repairs, work orders, parts inventory, and inspection reports.
Safety Compliance:
*Adhere to all safety regulations and procedures while performing maintenance tasks.
*Other responsibilities deemed necessary by supervisor
QUALIFICATIONS:
Technical Skills:
*Proficient knowledge of basic plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general maintenance practices. 
Problem-Solving:
*Ability to diagnose issues, troubleshoot problems, and find effective solutions. 
Physical Ability:
*Comfortable with manual labor, lifting heavy objects, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces. 
Customer Service:
*Commitment to providing timely and quality service to residents. 
Time Management:
*Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple work orders, and meet deadlines.
Valid Driver's License:
*Reliable transportation to travel to and from properties.
Physical Requirements and work environment:
*Primarily working outdoors and indoors on various residential or commercial properties.
*Exposure to various weather conditions
*Ability to lift 50 100 lbs. following appropriate safety procedures
*Work in an upright standing position for extended periods of time
*Crawl in small and tight spaces
*Walk and climb stairs, handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; Reach with hands and arms; Communicate, receive and exchange ideas and information by means of the spoken and written word
*Ability to navigate the property/building quickly and easily as required to meet the job functions
*Ability to detect auditory and/or visual emergency alarms
*Specific responsibilities and requirements may vary depending on the size and type of property management company, as well as local regulations.
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
*High school diploma or equivalency. Requires a minimum of two (2) years’ general experience in building trades
*Bilingual preferred
*Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
FLSA CLASS: Non-Exempt
REPORTS TO: Community Manager
SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None
JOB CATEGORY: Maintenance
POSITION CLASS: Maintenance
COMPETENCIES:
Treats everyone with respect, compassion and kindness – Builds internal respect and loyalty with customers. Demonstrate concern for customers. Effectively responds to customer needs. This includes responding timely to requests, listening to others, and seeking to understand others when there are differences of opinion, finding ways to build on each other’s ideas.  Acts with empathy and focus, while able to resolve problems.
Demonstrate integrity, transparency and doing things the right way – Makes lemonade out of lemons. This includes following policies, demonstrating financial responsibility with Lakeshore assets, complying with state and federal law, and practicing safety. Conforms to the highest professional standard. Turns challenges into wins.
Collaboration and teamwork – Involve key stakeholders in decision making. This includes developing and maintaining positive work relationships. Enhances the level of mutual cooperation. Actively participates in team-oriented objectives and activities. Focus on team success, over individual.
Solves problems and is transparent about outcomes – Champions new initiatives beyond the scope of the department. Seeks to improve in all aspects of work performance. Creates an environment of continuous improvement and innovation. Encourages people to maintain high standards of quality and thoroughness.
Serves our employees and residents to improve their lives – This includes maintaining the property that creates curb appeal, a welcoming community environment, supports individual and family activities, creates a sense of neighborhood. At work, continually challenges self to grow and develop to be the best you can be at work.
COMPENSATION: $18.00 - $20.00/Hour (Based on experience) salary plus 5% quarterly bonus and 20% housing discount
LOCATION: Viking Terrace - Northfield, MN

Are you looking for a job that keeps you active, gets you outdoors, and allows you to travel across the country?
We are seeking hardworking, dependable individuals to join our traveling installation crew based out of Madison, WI. This is a unique opportunity to earn a strong income while seeing the country, with company-paid travel, lodging, and daily meal allowances.
No two projects are the same. You'll work alongside a dedicated team installing industrial tarping systems that protect material stockpiles from weather and contamination for customers throughout the United States.
If you enjoy physical work, teamwork, and being on the road, we'd like to hear from you.
Why Team Members Enjoy This Role
• Earn $50,000–$70,000+ annually
• Travel throughout the United States
• Paid lodging, travel, and daily meal allowance while on the road
• Company vehicle provided during projects
• Paid training provided
• Opportunity for advancement into Lead Installer and Crew Leadership roles
• Work outdoors and stay physically active
• Be part of a close-knit, hardworking team
What You'll Do
• Install and secure large industrial tarps using ropes, straps, anchors, and sandbags
• Lift, carry, and move materials weighing 50–75+ pounds on a regular basis
• Work safely at heights and in a variety of weather conditions
• Perform basic tarp repairs and sewing using portable equipment
• Follow all safety procedures, PPE requirements, and DOT regulations
• Maintain clean, organized, and professional job sites
• Represent the company professionally while traveling and working at customer locations
Travel & Schedule
• This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy travel and outdoor work.
• Travel throughout the United States
• Typical travel rotations are 12–14 days at a time

title: Vending Machine Stocker - 10-20 hours/week, flexible hours
body:
We're looking for a Vending Machine Stocker to handle restocking machines at multiple locations throughout the Minneapolis Metro Area. We're based out of a warehouse in St. Anthony Park, so you'd pick up the goods there and drive them to the locations to restock.
These restocks can be done at any time of the day Monday/Thursday or Tuesday/Friday, so this is great for college students, gig workers, or parents!

-A valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and current auto insurance. 
-A smartphone for route notes, stock photos and texting the us. 
Pay: $20/hour

Schedule: You choose between Monday/Thursday or Tuesday/Friday. Each location gets serviced once or twice a week. Occasional off-tempo restocks of some locations when warranted.
Time of day: Your call! Every building has 24-hour access, so early morning, mid-day, or late night work!
Based out of: St. Anthony Park warehouse
Engagement: 1099 independent contractor
Start: As soon as you're ready!
To apply: Email us with your name, your phone number, a resume if you have one, your vehicle's make and model, and which two days you'd plan to run. We reply within 1 business day and the whole process is a short call plus 2-3 ride-alongs. We read every email that comes in, so start yours with the word PRETZEL — that's how we know you made it this far

title: Maintenance Technician - 140
body:
SCOPE:
A Maintenance Technician in property management is responsible for performing a variety of repairs and maintenance tasks across residential or commercial properties, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general upkeep, responding to resident/tenant service requests, and ensuring the overall functionality and appearance of the property by completing routine inspections and preventative maintenance procedures, often requiring on-call availability for emergencies; reporting to the property manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintenance Repairs:
*Diagnose and repair plumbing issues like leaky faucets, clogged drains, and toilet malfunctions.
*Troubleshoot and fix electrical problems including faulty outlets, lighting fixtures, and wiring.
*Service HVAC systems, addressing issues with heating, cooling, and air filtration.
*Perform basic carpentry repairs like door and cabinet replacements, drywall patching, and trim work.
*Address appliance malfunctions.
*Conduct minor painting and touch-up work.
Preventative Maintenance:
*Regularly inspect building systems including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and fire safety equipment. 
*Perform routine checks on exterior building components like windows, doors, and siding. 
*Maintain landscaping and grounds as needed. 
*Monitor and replace worn-out parts to prevent future breakdowns. 
Resident Service Requests:
*Promptly respond to resident maintenance requests and work orders. 
*Communicate effectively with residents regarding repair status and updates. 
*Prioritize urgent repairs and address emergency situations. 
Administrative Tasks:
*Maintain accurate records of work orders, repairs completed, and parts inventory. 
*Coordinate with contractors for larger projects requiring specialized skills. 
*Adhere to safety protocols and building codes. 
Emergency Repairs:
May require on-call availability for emergency repairs 
Vendor Management:
Coordinate with outside contractors for complex repairs, obtaining quotes and overseeing work completion.
Documentation:
Maintain detailed records of repairs, work orders, parts inventory, and inspection reports.
Safety Compliance:
Adhere to all safety regulations and procedures while performing maintenance tasks.
Other responsibilities deemed necessary by supervisor
QUALIFICATIONS:
Technical Skills:
Proficient knowledge of basic plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general maintenance practices. 
Problem-Solving:
Ability to diagnose issues, troubleshoot problems, and find effective solutions. 
Physical Ability:
Comfortable with manual labor, lifting heavy objects, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces. 
Customer Service:
Commitment to providing timely and quality service to residents. 
Time Management:
Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple work orders, and meet deadlines.
Valid Driver's License:
Reliable transportation to travel to and from properties.
Physical Requirements and work environment:
*Primarily working outdoors and indoors on various residential or commercial properties.
*Exposure to various weather conditions
*Ability to lift 50 100 lbs. following appropriate safety procedures
*Work in an upright standing position for extended periods of time
*Crawl in small and tight spaces
*Walk and climb stairs, handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; Reach with hands and arms; Communicate, receive and exchange ideas and information by means of the spoken and written word
*Ability to navigate the property/building quickly and easily as required to meet the job functions
*Ability to detect auditory and/or visual emergency alarms
*Specific responsibilities and requirements may vary depending on the size and type of property management company, as well as local regulations.
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
High school diploma or equivalency. Requires a minimum of two (2) years’ general experience in building trades
Bilingual preferred
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

title: Carpenter
body:
Job Title: Entry-Level Carpenter / Carpenter Apprentice
Company: Dodge Brothers Construction
Location: Amery, WI
Position Type: Full-Time 
About Us:
Dodge Brothers Construction is a premier residential builder based in Amery, Wisconsin. We specialize in high-quality home construction, framing, and remodeling. We take pride in our precise field execution, strong structural standards, and professional team culture. We are looking for a reliable, hard-working individual who wants to build a long-term career in the trades and learn from our experienced senior crew. 
Position Overview:
This is a full-time, entry-level position. You do not need years of experience, but you must bring a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn, and a reliable attitude every single day. You will work directly under our senior carpenters, assisting with residential framing, layout, trimming, and general job site operations while learning the trade from the ground up. 
Core Responsibilities: 
• Field Assistance: Assist senior carpenters with framing walls, installing joists, sheathing roofs, and setting windows and doors. 
• Material Handling: Safely load, unload, stage, and organize lumber, tools, and construction materials across the job site. 
• Job Site Maintenance: Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment by sweeping, clearing debris, and packing up tools at the end of the shift. 
• Tool Operation: Safely operate basic hand and power tools (miter saws, circular saws, drills, pneumatic nail guns) under direct supervision. 
• Policy Compliance: Arrive on time daily, follow all job site safety protocols, and follow directions precisely to ensure structural quality. 
Required Qualifications: 
• Punctuality: A strict commitment to showing up on time, every single day, ready to work at the designated start time. 
• Attitude: A proactive, teachable mindset with the ability to take direction well and listen to senior crew members. 
• Physical Ability: Able to lift 50+ lbs consistently, work on your feet in varying Wisconsin weather conditions, and handle heights/ladders comfortably. 
• Transportation: A valid driver’s license and reliable transportation to get to various job sites around the Amery area. 
• Basic Tools: Possession of basic personal hand tools (pouch, tape measure, speed square, hammer) or the willingness to acquire them. 
What We Offer: 
• Competitive entry-level hourly wage based on initial aptitude. 
• Direct, hands-on mentorship and training from skilled senior carpenters. 
• A steady, reliable, and professional work environment. 
• Clear pathways for growth and wage increases as your skills develop.
To Apply:
Please submit your resume, contact information, and a brief summary of why you want to learn the carpentry trade with Dodge Brothers Construction.

-Verify deliveries against packing slips and purchase orders.

-Organize inventory to make commonly used items easy to locate.

-Keep the shop clean, organized, and safe.

-Assist with maintaining shop equipment and work areas.

-Ensure the shop is prepared for daily installation and service operations.
Tools & Equipment:

-Inspect tools and equipment for damage or missing items.
-Coordinate repairs or replacement of damaged equipment.
-Maintain organized tool storage.
-Prepare tool and equipment packages for installation and service crews.
-Track equipment assigned to vehicles or employees when appropriate.
-Ensure equipment is returned and accounted for after jobs.
Purchasing & Vendor Support:
-Communicate material and supply needs to management.
-Assist with placing orders for warehouse and shop supplies when authorized.
-Receive and verify vendor deliveries.
-Maintain organized records of packing slips and deliveries.
-Report shortages, incorrect shipments, or damaged materials to management.
Safety & Organization:
-Maintain a clean and safe warehouse and shop environment.
-Keep walkways, exits, work areas, and storage areas clear.
-Follow company safety procedures.
-Properly store tools, equipment, materials, and supplies.
-Report safety hazards or unsafe conditions to management.
-Assist with maintaining required safety supplies and equipment.
Administrative Duties:
-Maintain inventory spreadsheets or inventory-management software.
-Enter received materials and inventory adjustments accurately.
-Maintain records of equipment and tools.
-Organize purchase orders, packing slips, and delivery documentation.

-Ability to work independently and manage priorities.
-Dependable and punctual.
-Comfortable working in a hands-on environment.
-Basic computer and data-entry skills.
-Ability to lift and move materials and equipment appropriate to the job.
-Ability to operate basic warehouse equipment safely.
-Valid driver's license required.
-Experience with inventory or business-management software is a plus.
Personal Characteristics:
The successful candidate will be:
Organized — knows where everything is and keeps it that way.
Dependable — completes assigned work without constant supervision.
Detail-oriented — maintains accurate inventory and catches discrepancies.
Proactive — identifies problems and addresses them before they affect the field team.
Hands-on — willing to physically organize, move, prepare, and maintain materials and equipment.
Safety-conscious — maintains a clean and safe work environment.
Team-oriented — understands that a well-run warehouse helps the entire company succeed.
Accountable — takes ownership of the warehouse, shop, inventory, and equipment.

title: Part-time House Manager & Family Assistant
body:
Job Title: Part-time House Manager & Family Assistant
Location: Lake Elmo, MN 55042
Employment Type: Part-Time | 15-20 hours per week (15 guaranteed)
Schedule: Flexible; 3 to 5 days per week. Candidates are able to set their own consistent day-time schedule.
Compensation: $28-$32 per hour, commensurate with experience
Start Date: ASAP
REQUIREMENTS:
•Maintain a smoke-free environment
•Must be authorized to work in the United States
•Reliable transportation required with valid license and clean driving record; use of a family vehicle is available and preferred
•Ability to navigate multiple flights of stairs throughout the day and lift up to 40 pounds for limited periods of time
•Comfortable working in a home with pets (one small senior dog and one young cat cat)
ABOUT OUR FAMILY:
We are a warm, busy, and close-knit family of three who recently returned to Lake Elmo after a year living in Texas and are in the process of making this house truly feel like home. Both adults work full-time from home, often with back-to-back calls and meetings from morning through afternoon. Our daughter is a bright, independent young teen that thrives with consistency and calm in her space. Our household also includes two beloved pets: an elder Chiweenie and a young cat who both bring a lot of life to the space.
We’re community-minded, relational, and laid-back, with a strong work ethic and a lot of heart for hosting. We’re intentional about bringing people together and celebrating those we care about, and we want our home to feel organized, welcoming, and comfortable—even when life is moving fast.
The right person will feel less like hired help and more like a trusted partner in keeping this household humming.
WHO YOU ARE / WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:
You are:
•A natural self-starter: You walk into a home, notice what needs attention, and get to work—without needing to be told twice.
•Proactive, creative, and organized: You spot opportunities to improve a system and take the initiative to make it happen.
•Ready to tackle a little of everything: Restocking the pantry, designing a closet system, sourcing the perfect gift basket, or getting the guest bathroom ready for company.
•Comfortable working independently: You’re happy listening to a podcast or audiobook and won’t be thrown off by a Zoom call down the hall.
•A clear, proactive communicator: You keep the family informed about your schedule and give plenty of notice when something needs to shift.
•Sensitive and emotionally intelligent: You pick up on individual needs, adapt naturally, and know when to be present and when to give space.
•Respectful of personal spaces: You’re especially thoughtful about the belongings and boundaries of teens in the home.
•Creative and hospitality-minded: You enjoy thoughtful details—from beautiful gift baskets to themed dinners—that make people feel genuinely welcomed.
•Someone who brings ideas, not just execution.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Household Organization & Maintenance:
•Create, maintain, and evolve household organization systems throughout the home
•Perform daily resets to keep common areas tidy: wipe surfaces, load/unload dishes, vacuum high-traffic areas, etc.
•Prepare the home for the bi-weekly cleaning service
•Manage seasonal clothing transitions, including prompting and facilitating size reviews
•Coordinate donation drop-offs (Goodwill and similar) and explore resale options where appropriate
•Change batteries, light bulbs, and smoke detector batteries proactively and maintain stock of these items
•Prepare home for guests: ensure TVs are set up and logged in, remotes are charged, towels and coffee are laid out, and bathrooms are guest-ready
Inventory & Errands:
•Manage running household supply list
•Grocery shop in-store or arrange delivery and maintain stock of preferred items for all family members
•Maintain intentional back stock of pantry staples, household supplies, and toiletries, including travel-size items
•Manage and execute household orders and subscriptions
•Keep the bar and snack area fully stocked for hosting
•Handle weekly errands (e.g. returns, gift shopping, grocery shopping) efficiently, batching tasks by day and location
•Retrieve mail from the mailbox several times per week; open household packages as needed and breakdown boxes for recycling
Laundry & Linens:
•Wash, fold, and organize laundry for the full household
•Rotate and refresh linens and towels
•Maintain a tidy and well-stocked laundry area
•Special Projects
•Organize closets and seasonal gear, creating practical systems that make the home easier to maintain
•Lead home-improvement projects, from planning closet built-ins and mudroom doors to sourcing materials and hardware
•Support event and holiday hosting, including themed dinners, seasonal celebrations, and football game prep (snacks, decor, logistics)
•Clean Pura filters throughout the home; monitor and adjust settings to manage pet-related odors
•Research, purchase, and wrap gifts; assemble gift baskets for extended family members for holidays, birthdays, and back-to-school
Meal Support:
•Prepare crockpot meals 1-2 times per week using provided recipes
•Process and prep produce (wash, chop, store)
•Prepare batch snacks and breakfast items (e.g.protein balls, egg bites) as requested
•Maintain a clean and organized kitchen space
Pet Care:
•Feed and monitor the dog and cat as needed
•Schedule and transport the dog to routine veterinary appointments (approximately every 4-6 weeks for injections)
•Sweep and tidy the pet area
•Maintain pet supply inventory
•Coordinate optional grooming appointments as needed
Vehicle Upkeep:
•Fuel family vehicles proactively
•Schedule and transport vehicles for routine maintenance
•Occasionally wipe and vacuum car interiors and coordinate car washes
•Track registration and insurance documents; ensure paperwork is current and kept in the vehicle
Vendor & Property Oversight:
•Serve as the on-site point of contact for vendors and service providers
•Find deep cleaning service and delegate tasks (e.g. oven, baseboards)
•Research and coordinate repair quotes and build/maintain a reliable vendor contact list (windows, HVAC, electrician, etc.)
•Create and manage a seasonal home maintenance calendar; delegate and oversee tasks such as winterizing, hose storage, and summer prep
•Coordinate with the landscaping crew on outdoor project goals; help develop a polished and functional deck and patio space
Administrative & Family Support:
•Manage household calendar proactively: look ahead for upcoming events, school activities, anniversaries, and appointments and plan ahead for preparation needs (e.g. ordering gifts, managing teacher appreciation items)
•Schedule and coordinate recurring appointments for the family (medical, dental, haircuts, etc.) and other miscellaneous appointments as requested
•Support event planning and coordination (e.g. milestone celebrations and themed gatherings)
•Assist with personal travel logistics: research accommodations, coordinate dinner reservations, and handle bookings in a warm and professional manner
•Track receipts for all employee-related expenses
HOW TO APPLY:
If interested, please visit https://sage-haus.breezy.hr/p/8a468099c45b-part-time-house-manager-family-assistant?state=published to submit the following:
•A brief letter explaining why you would be a great fit for this position
•Your updated resume
•At least 3 professional references with contact information
Note that this role requires a background check.
When you apply with Sage Haus, you’ll also be added to our candidate community email list so we can share hiring updates, resources, and opportunities. Don’t worry — you can unsubscribe at any time if it’s not for you.

title: Line Cook - Elk Avenue Prime
body:
Do You Love Great Food, Craft, and Mountain Living as Much as We Do?
Work Hard. Play Hard. Live Fully in Crested Butte.
Apply directly through this link for the quickest response: https://fm.bamboohr.com/careers/35 
At Elk Ave Hospitality, we are building teams for people who want more than just a job. We are looking for individuals who want to work hard, grow their skills, be part of a strong team, and enjoy the unmatched lifestyle that comes with living in the Gunnison Valley.
If you love cooking, take pride in disciplined execution, and enjoy working in a fast-paced kitchen where standards matter, we want to hear from you.
Whether your passion is skiing first tracks, biking wildflower-lined trails, fishing alpine waters, or simply soaking in the beauty of the Rockies, this is your chance to build a life that blends professional growth with personal adventure.
We are growing quickly and actively building career paths for people who want to develop their knowledge, expand their skills, and contribute to a strong hospitality culture.
What You Can Expect
A positive, team-oriented work environment
Ongoing training, learning, and development
Opportunities for growth and advancement within Elk Ave Hospitality
Employee housing opportunities, depending on the role and availability
Competitive hourly pay based on experience
The opportunity to live and work in one of Colorado’s most remarkable mountain communities
This is an hourly role, and compensation is based on experience. Hourly positions are not immediately eligible for health benefits or paid time off.
Who We’re Looking For
You may be a strong fit if you:
Work well as part of a team
Take pride in quality, consistency, and execution
Can thrive in a fast-paced kitchen environment
Value cleanliness, organization, and readiness
Can follow systems, standards, recipes, and prep expectations
Want to learn and grow
Bring a positive attitude, professionalism, and accountability to work each day
Care about doing things the right way, every shift
Our core values are Communication, Humility, Accountability, Integrity, and Respect, and we are looking for team members who want to live those values in the workplace.
What Will Be Expected of You
Depending on the role, team members may be expected to:
Maintain a professional appearance and follow dress and uniform standards
Obtain and maintain food safety certifications as required by the role
Work mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during busy seasonal periods
Communicate clearly and work effectively with both teammates and leadership
Help maintain clean, organized, safe, and service-ready work areas
Work with consistency, urgency, and a team-first attitude
Be open to learning multiple areas of the kitchen when appropriate
For kitchen roles, food safety certification such as ServSafe may be preferred or required depending on the position.
Cross-Training and Growth
We believe in building flexible, well-rounded kitchen teams through cross-training. Each team member will have a primary role based on their strongest skills and experience, along with the opportunity to take on secondary responsibilities based on their willingness to learn and grow.
This approach helps employees build a broader understanding of the kitchen, develop new skills, and create more consistent opportunities as business levels shift throughout the season. We have found that this model supports both team success and individual growth while keeping advancement top of mind.
About Elk Ave Hospitality
Elk Ave Hospitality is a growing family of restaurants and hospitality businesses in Crested Butte and the Gunnison Valley. Our venues offer a wide range of guest experiences, from elevated dining to approachable everyday hospitality, all rooted in quality, consistency, and genuine care for our guests and our team.
We believe hospitality can be both a craft and a career. With multiple venues, varied concepts, and opportunities for advancement, we are able to offer year-round employment, cross-training, and real pathways for growth. We are building a company for people who want to work hard, contribute to a strong team culture, and grow their skills over time.
About Elk Prime
Elk Prime is Elk Ave Hospitality’s elevated steakhouse concept, focused on polished service, high-quality ingredients, and a refined guest experience. The restaurant blends an upscale atmosphere with warm, approachable hospitality, creating a setting where attention to detail, professionalism, and teamwork matter at every level.
Elk Prime is built for team members who take pride in craft, consistency, and execution. From the dining room to the kitchen, the standard is high, and the opportunity for growth is real. For hospitality professionals looking to develop within a more refined service environment, Elk Prime offers the chance to be part of a serious team in one of Crested Butte’s premier dining settings.
Opportunities Available
Elk Prime is hiring for the following opportunity:
Line Cook
Position Summary
As a Line Cook, I play an important role in supporting daily back-of-house operations at Elk Prime. I prepare and execute food to company standards, maintain station organization and cleanliness, and contribute to a kitchen environment built on teamwork, consistency, and urgency.
This role is ideal for a culinary professional who works well under pressure, communicates clearly, and takes pride in disciplined execution. I bring a strong work ethic, attention to detail, and a commitment to food quality, cleanliness, and team success.
Benefits and Perks
Competitive hourly pay based on experience
Employee housing opportunities
Opportunities for growth and advancement within Elk Ave Hospitality
The chance to live and work in one of Colorado’s most remarkable mountain communities
Key Responsibilities
Station Execution and Food Preparation
As a Line Cook at Elk Prime, I prepare and cook menu items according to company standards for quality, consistency, and presentation.
I take ownership of my assigned station and ensure it is organized, stocked, and service-ready.
I execute prep, cooking, seasoning, and plating responsibilities with accuracy and urgency.
I maintain a strong understanding of recipes, specs, and station expectations.
I support the kitchen team in delivering a smooth, coordinated, and efficient service.
Teamwork and Kitchen Support
I communicate clearly with chefs, cooks, and support staff throughout prep and service.
I work collaboratively with the kitchen team to ensure all dishes are prepared and sent out in a timely manner.
I assist with station transitions, prep support, and general kitchen needs as directed by leadership.
I help maintain a positive, disciplined, and team-oriented kitchen culture.
I support the training and example-setting expected in a professional kitchen environment.
Organization, Cleanliness, and Food Safety
I maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary station throughout each shift.
I follow all food safety, sanitation, storage, labeling, and rotation procedures.
I ensure ingredients, tools, and equipment are properly handled, maintained, and stored.
I help uphold health department standards and company expectations in all food-related work areas.
I support a culture of pride, cleanliness, and operational discipline throughout the kitchen.
Quality and Consistency
I maintain consistency in flavor, execution, portioning, and presentation.
I taste, adjust, and execute food with attention to detail and quality standards.
I stay focused and organized during high-volume periods while maintaining accuracy.
I contribute to a kitchen environment where quality and consistency are expected at every station.
Qualifications
Previous professional kitchen experience preferred
Two to three years of station cooking experience in a professional kitchen is strongly preferred
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively as part of a team
Strong work ethic, reliability, and willingness to learn
Ability to maintain focus, urgency, and quality standards during busy service periods
Preferred Skills and Experience
Strong foundation in cooking techniques, including knife skills, sautéing, grilling, roasting, and frying
Familiarity with ingredients, flavor profiles, and proper product handling and storage
Comfort using kitchen tools, equipment, and appliances including ovens, grills, fryers, and stovetops
Food safety certification such as ServSafe is preferred
Strong attention to detail with portioning, plating, and recipe execution
Ability to multitask, stay organized, and work efficiently under pressure
Passion for food and a genuine interest in culinary growth and development
Physical and Position Requirements
Must be able to stand and move continuously for extended periods of time
Must be able to walk, bend, twist, stoop, stretch, and lift throughout each shift
Must be able to work efficiently in a crowded, fast-paced kitchen environment
Must be capable of adjusting to changes in pace, priorities, and business volume
Must be able to lift and carry kitchen items and products as needed
Must be able to work mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as needed in a seasonal hospitality environment
Must be able to work in an environment with temperature fluctuations, hot surfaces, sharp tools, kitchen equipment, cleaning chemicals, and loud background noise
Important Position Information
This is an hourly, non-exempt position. Compensation is based on experience. Hourly positions are not immediately eligible for health benefits or paid time off.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
Success in this position means maintaining a clean, organized, and well-executed station while contributing to a kitchen team that performs with consistency, urgency, and pride. The right candidate works hard, communicates well, lives the core values, and helps ensure Elk Prime delivers food and execution that match the standards of the brand.

title: Assistant General Manager
body:
Apply Now Lead with purpose. Grow with support. At Panera, our leaders are celebrated for bringing out the best in their teams. Enjoy great perks, a welcoming culture, and the opportunity to make a real impact—every day. Get ready to rise and come join the fun where you will be a part of making the familiar fantastic! Because at Panera, the best thing of bread is sharing it! What’s In It for You? Competitive pay & eligible for quarterly bonuses Free on-shift meals & unlimited fountain beverages Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, pet insurance & 401(k) with match available Career advancement & leadership development opportunities Tuition discounts Perks & rewards for team members Team member assistance program And much, much more! As an Assistant General Manager, you’ll lead an amazing team and a beloved neighborhood bakery-cafe to sweet success! You’ll inspire and celebrate your team, partner with your General Manager in overseeing operations, delight guests every day, and grow the business- while taking ownership on hiring, training, and development at your location. As Assistant General Manager Panera, Your Role Includes: Support your General Manager by making key decisions and problem solving. Plan and manage staffing needs, shift scheduling, people development, career development, and succession planning. Support the hiring, on-boarding, and training of new team members while motivating energizing, engaging, inspiring, and celebrating the entire team. Assist with managing team performance to ensure the bakery-cafe’s goals, operational and quality standards, and extraordinary guest service expectations are met. Partner with the General Manager to create subject matter experts within your bakery-cafe by developing managers on people’s processes and Panera’s Guiding Values & Behaviors. Work as a team to ensure every guest is delighted by the quality of our food, service, and our team. Build engaging relationships that lead to long-term, loyal guests as part of the bakery-cafe’s management team. Follow operational procedures designed to ensure your bakery-cafe successfully executes all company strategies and initiatives. Ensure team members follow company policies and procedures and comply with all federal, state and local regulations. Maintain a healthy and safe workplace for your team that meets Panera’s health, food, safety, and company culture standards. Assist your General Manager in maintaining the bakery-cafe’s overall costs and inventory. Help build our Culture of warmth, belonging, growth, and trust. This Opportunity Is for You If: Minimum age: 18 years of age. 1+ years of restaurant management experience preferred. ServSafe certification (or ability to achieve). Proven ability to drive positive results through strong business acumen required. Proven availability to run great shifts while directing, motivating, coaching and developing others in a fast-paced environment. This role requires flexible hours including nights and weekends in a faced-paced environment with shifting priorities. Any job offer for this position is conditional upon the results of a background check. While performing this job, the Assistant General Manager role is regularly required to: Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull objects 50 pounds. Capability to stand and walk for up to 6 hours. Must be able to clearly communicate and quickly understand guests and associates’ directions in a loud environment. Be an ambassador of our Guiding Values and Behaviors by making people smile, learning and growing together, finding solutions and taking initiative, working (and winning) as a team, having fun and celebrating success, and seeing the best in others! __ Equal Opportunity Employer: Disabled/Veterans 
 Additional Description : 
 Pay: $23.50 - $26 an hour Apply Now

title: Restaurant Assistant General Manager - FOH
body:
Lead a high-volume restaurant, inspire a great team, and grow your career at R Social on Main!
About R Social on Main
R Social on Main is a high-volume, full-service restaurant and bar in Rogers, Minnesota, featuring multiple bars, rooftop dining, and a vibrant atmosphere. We're known for great food, craft cocktails, and creating memorable guest experiences.
We're looking for an experienced, motivated Assistant General Manager (AGM) who leads by example, takes ownership of their shifts, and thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment.
The ideal candidate is a confident, hands-on leader who understands restaurant operations, develops strong teams, maintains exceptional service standards, and knows how to balance hospitality with profitability.
This is a leadership position with significant responsibility, operational autonomy, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a growing restaurant business.
Key Responsibilities
Restaurant Operations & Leadership
Independently lead daily restaurant and bar operations, ensuring smooth, efficient service.
Maintain a strong floor presence, especially during high-volume dinner and weekend shifts.
Direct and support servers, bartenders, hosts, and support staff to deliver an exceptional guest experience.
Take ownership of assigned shifts, proactively addressing challenges and making sound operational decisions.
Maintain consistent standards for service, cleanliness, professionalism, and overall restaurant performance.
Team Development & Accountability
Coach, train, and motivate employees to achieve high standards of hospitality and performance.
Set clear expectations, provide constructive feedback, and hold team members accountable.
Assist with hiring, onboarding, scheduling, and employee development.
Foster a positive, professional, team-oriented work environment.
Financial & Operational Performance
Manage staffing levels, scheduling, and labor costs based on sales volume and operational needs.
Make timely staffing adjustments to maintain efficient service and labor performance.
Oversee cash handling, closing procedures, and daily operational reporting.
Partner with the General Manager to achieve sales, labor, and profitability objectives.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary costs, and strengthen restaurant performance.
Guest Experience & Compliance
Deliver outstanding hospitality while confidently resolving guest concerns.
Ensure compliance with food safety, responsible alcohol service, and applicable health regulations.
Uphold company policies, operational procedures, and workplace safety standards.
Qualifications
Required
Minimum 3 years of restaurant management experience, preferably in a high-volume, full-service restaurant or bar.
Proven experience independently managing busy restaurant shifts and leading front-of-house teams.
Strong understanding of restaurant labor management, staffing, and scheduling.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and hold employees accountable.
Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong professionalism, reliability, and sound judgment.
Ability to remain composed, decisive, and effective in a fast-paced environment.
Availability to work evenings, weekends, and closing shifts.
Preferred
Experience managing high-volume restaurants with multiple dining areas or bars.
Familiarity with restaurant financial performance, including labor costs, sales reporting, and controllable expenses.
Experience with Toast POS or comparable restaurant management systems.
Background in casual upscale dining, independent restaurants, or hospitality-driven restaurant groups.
Schedule: Full-time, primarily evenings and weekends. Current schedule includes Thursday through Monday closing shifts.
Why Join R Social?
At R Social, we value strong leadership, teamwork, accountability, and genuine hospitality. Our management team plays an essential role in creating an environment where employees are supported, guests feel welcome, and the restaurant continues to succeed.
We're looking for more than someone who can supervise a shift. We want a leader who takes initiative, earns the respect of their team, and treats the restaurant's success as a personal responsibility.
If you're an experienced restaurant manager ready to take ownership, lead a strong team, and make a lasting impact, we'd love to hear from you.
Pay: $65,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year
Benefits:
401(k) matching
Health Insurance reimbursement stipend
Employee discount
Paid time off
Potential for performance bonus

title: Artisan Baker / Pastry Baker / Bread Baker in Chaska
body:
Why Join Us?
At Heaven Gluten-Free Bakery, we take pride in crafting scratch-made sourdough. We know that baking is physically demanding craft work, and we believe in taking care of the people who make it happen.
When you work with us, you can expect:
Predictable Schedules: Consistent days off and stable shift times so you can plan your personal life.
Supportive Environment: A team that values respect, clear communication, and manageable production paces over chaotic scrambles.
Fair Compensation: Competitive hourly base pay

What You’ll Do
Prepare, mix, scale, shape, and bake breads / pastries according to bakery recipes and standards.
Monitor proofing, fermentation times, and oven temperatures to ensure consistent product quality.
Maintain clean, organized workstations and adhere to sanitation and food safety regulations.
Assist with basic inventory tracking, ingredient prep, and station setup/breakdown.
Collaborate with our front-of-house and back-of-house teams to ensure timely morning production.
What We’re Looking For
Experience: no prior experience/open to passionate home bakers with strong kitchen discipline.
Reliability: Punctuality and dependable attendance for early shifts.
Attention to Detail: Pride in product consistency, weight scaling, and dough handling.
Team Mindset: Willingness to pitch in with cleanup, dishwashing, and prep when needed.
Physical Capability: Ability to stand for the duration of a shift and lift ingredient sacks (up to 50 lbs) safely.

title: Sandwich Crew – Part-Time, Weekday Lunch, No Nights or Weekends (Downt
body:
PaperBoy is hiring part-time crew
PaperBoy is a Tuscan-inspired sandwich shop in the Baker Center skyway, downtown Minneapolis. We build big, bold Italian sandwiches on schiacciata baked fresh every morning, and we serve them to a downtown lunch crowd that shows up hungry and on a schedule.
We're looking for part-time crew members who can do a little of everything: build sandwiches on the line, run the counter, and keep the shop moving during the lunch rush.
The schedule
Weekday lunch shifts, roughly 10:30am–2:30pm. No nights. No weekends. Your evenings are yours.
Pay
$17/hr + tips. With tips, crew averages $21–25/hr.
What you'll do
You'll prep and build sandwiches to spec, take orders and run the register, keep the line and counter clean and stocked, and help the team get through a fast, busy lunch window without losing quality.
What we're looking for
Some food service experience is preferred (kitchen, café, counter, fast casual, anything where you've worked a rush). You should be reliable and on time, comfortable on your feet for a full shift, friendly with customers, and able to stay calm and organized when the line is out the door. If you care about food and like doing things the right way, you'll fit in here.
Why work here
Consistent weekday hours, a small team, and a real craft-focused kitchen. You'll learn how to build sandwiches the way they do it in Florence, and you'll be part of a young brand that's growing.
To apply
Reply to this post with a few sentences about yourself, any food service experience, and which weekdays you're available. A resume is preferred but not required.

title: Prep Cook - Pizzeria Lola

Pizzeria Lola is the flagship restaurant for James Beard award winning Chef Ann Kim. We are committed to crafting craveable experiences for every guest that walks through our doors, and in this case, for every guest at Pizzeria Lola’s Trailer at Indeed Brewing. Our dedication to delivering the highest quality product extends to every aspect of our operations, including mobile operations. We are committed to providing a work environment that is supportive, inclusive, and committed to your growth and wellbeing.
Prep Cook Position Profile
Overview: Prep Cooks are responsible for preparing ingredients and recipes to quality standards. They follow daily and weekly prep lists, ensuring fresh, quality components of the menu are on-hand and properly rotated and stored. Prep Cooks must be knowledgeable about various prep & cooking techniques, practice safe knife skills, and maintain a clean work environment. 
Reports To: Chef de Cuisine
Takes Direction From: BOH and FOH leadership team; Manager on Duty or shift supervisor
Key Responsibilities:
Food Preparation - preps ingredients for all menu items to be used in service
Teamwork - engages with teammates and management to meet shared goals and expectations
Health and Safety - complies with policies that protect the team and environment
Core Competencies
Culinary Skill: follows recipes, processes, and ingredient preparation
Clear Communication: expresses self well and understands others to create clarity
Organization: has reliable systems that allows them to effectively prioritize, multitask, and meet expectations in a timely manner
Flexibility: shares and is open to feedback; can take and give direction to find creative solutions
Problem-solving Skills: consistently makes sound decisions with and without support
Related Qualifications 
Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for long periods, lift and carry items up to 40lbs, perform repetitive tasks, and work various shifts, including weekends and holidays.
Alignment with Vestalia Purpose, Vision, and Values
Why We Exist: We craft craveable experiences.
What We Do: We challenge and surprise every person who comes through our doors with a fiery passion for food, hospitality and the people who surround us. We open people’s eyes to what a restaurant experience can be.
Values: 
Presence - I show up with focused attention
Heart - I give a damn
Curiosity - I am open to other perspectives and possibilities
Creativity - I take action to achieve goals or bring about positive change
Prep Cook Job Description
Key Responsibilities 
Food Preparation
Prepare ingredients that meet quality standards and ensure everything is ready for dish execution
Ingredients: wash, peel, chop, and measure product to set standards 
Recipes: follow all instructions and processes to produce components of the menu that will be utilized in service
Cooking assistance: help with cooking tasks as necessary or directed in preparation of food, including but not limited to boiling, sautéing, grilling, or baking
Participate in creation of family meal or other non-menu item foods as invited or directed by CdC or MOD
Help with order receiving and storing
Take action to ensure food inventory quality, proper rotation & storage, and keep necessary pars; report issues to MOD promptly
Practice safety techniques when using knives or other sharp objects to prepare food; appropriately operate only kitchen equipment you are trained to use
Maintain understanding of culinary vision 
Teamwork
Contribute to a satisfying and effective work environment
Maintain open and efficient communication with team members and managers to support smooth service
Recognize challenging situations and enlist support from team and management to navigate them
Engage in lateral service - help other BOH team members, in all roles, as necessary or directed by a supervisor to complete tasks you’re capable of doing to collaboratively meet the needs of guests and teammates; ask for and accept help when necessary
Take responsibility to complete all assigned opening, in service, closing, and periodic side work
Consistently show up and act within set values to sustain a respectful work environment
Maintain optimal balance of professionalism, sincerity, and care in guest and team member interactions
Report and promptly resolve personal conflict or performance issues with others on the team
Participate as invited, interested, and trained to work off-site catering, event, or concessions opportunities
Health and Safety
Contribute to a safe work environment
Maintain clean and organized spaces in the kitchen and shared team member work areas
Follow all federal, state, and local health, safety, & hygiene regulations
Follow all organizational and restaurant policies related to conduct and employment expectations
Report health issues and injuries immediately to the manager on duty
Report maintenance issues for equipment or facilities to CdC or MOD
Stay up-to-date on safe food handling and Harassment Prevention training; act in accordance with rules, regulations, and expectations set in training
Attend daily pre- or post-shift check-ins to stay informed on daily priorities; proactively seek information to stay informed if meeting attendance isn’t possible
Attend required meetings, reviews, and general job training sessions
Prep Cook Job Description
Conditions of Satisfaction and Agreement
Performance Indicators
We’ll take into consideration many factors when assessing your performance in your role. Some key indicators include but are not limited to:
Peer Feedback: Team members consistently report satisfaction with your attitude and ability to meet role expectations
Food Quality: Consistently creates food that meets all standards, and takes action to course-correct when standard is missed
Efficiency: Demonstrates timely and prompt completion of tasks
Teamwork: Engages regularly in effective collaboration with colleagues and management.
Compliance: Adheres to health and safety standards and restaurant policies.
This job description is intended to provide guidelines for job expectations and your ability to perform the position described. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities and additional functions and requirements may be assigned by us as we may do from time to time. Nothing in this job description restricts our right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Employment is at-will, and nothing in this job description is intended to create or imply a contractual relationship or alter your at-will status. You will be required to follow all our policies and procedures.

Apply Now At Panera Bread, we believe every guest deserves our best. As a Restaurant Team Member , you’ll be the heart of hospitality- bringing warmth, care, and joy to every interaction. Restaurant Team Members have the special opportunity to connect with our amazing guests, directly impact the bakery-cafe’s growing business, and most importantly serve local communities across the country. Support in bringing Panera warmth to life and help ensure every guest receives our best. By sharing a warm welcome, delivering food with gratitude, always looking for ways to help, building personal connections, and finding moments to surprise and delight, you help create meaningful experiences that keep guests coming back. Responsibilities As a Restaurant Team Member, you will be an ambassador for bringing Panera Warmth to life with each guest interaction, delivering excellent services in every circumstance. Your daily responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Restaurant Team Members will execute the duties for their specific areas within the bakery-cafe (e.g., Production, Prep, Service, Cashier, Expo, Drive-Thru, Barista, Guest Experience Champion, QC, etc.). Greet every guest with genuine warmth and enthusiasm. Assemble fresh salads, soups, and sandwiches with care, accuracy, and efficiency – no assembly lines, just real ingredients and great food. Stay on the move – assist guests at entry, cashier, and dining areas. Maintain a clean, safe, and inviting environment by following food safety standards and cleaning protocols. Be informed about daily priorities and adapt to changes with a positive attitude – every guest gets our best. Support team success by completing cleaning and stocking duties and helping set up the next shift. What’s In It for You Competitive pay & eligible for team tips Free on-shift meals & unlimited fountain beverages Flexible, reliable scheduling Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays (for full-time team members) Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, pet insurance & 401(k) with match available Career advancement & leadership development opportunities Tuition discounts Perks & rewards for team members Team member assistance program This Opportunity Is for You If You meet the minimum age requirement (16+) and can lift up to 25 lbs. and stand for extended periods. Must be able to clearly communicate and quickly understand guests, managers, and team members’ directions in a loud environment. You have strong interpersonal skills and love making people smile. You’re passionate about creating moments of comfort, connection, and joy for every guest. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can multitask with ease. You’re reliable, punctual, and flexible to work evenings, weekends, and holidays. Complete basic food safety understanding and practice training. (Food Handler’s Card, as required by law) You enjoy working with food. (Food service experience is preferred but not required.) Equal Opportunity Employer: Disabled/Veterans

title: Team Manager
body:
Apply Now Lead with purpose. Grow with support. At Panera, our leaders are celebrated for bringing out the best in their teams. Enjoy great perks, a welcoming culture, and the opportunity to make a real impact—every day. Get ready to rise and come join the fun where you will be a part of making the familiar fantastic! Because at Panera, the best thing of bread is sharing it! What’s In It for You? Competitive pay & eligible for quarterly bonuses Free on-shift meals & unlimited fountain beverages Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, pet insurance & 401(k) with match available Career advancement & leadership development opportunities Tuition discounts Perks & rewards for team members Team member assistance program And much, much more! As a Team Manager, you’ll be part of the bakery-cafe’s leadership team, helping to run great shifts, support team development, and maintain the high standards our guests expect. As a Team Manager at Panera, Your Role Includes: Make sure every guest is delighted by the quality of our food, service, and staff. Build engaging relationships that lead to long-term, loyal guests. Lead, manager and develop team members by coaching, inspiring, and motivating them to exceed goals in sales, speed, order accuracy, and guest experience – and celebrate their achievements along the way. Participate in the interviewing and selection process. Train the team in food safety standards and ensure they are maintained. Help build our Culture of warmth, belonging, growth, and trust. This Opportunity Is for You If: Minimum age: 18 years of age. 1+ years of restaurant management experience preferred. Proven ability to lead great shifts while directing, motivating, coaching and developing others in a fast-paced environment. ServSafe certification (or ability to achieve certification). This role requires flexible hours including nights and weekends in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Any job offer for this position is conditional upon the results of a background check. While performing this job, the Team Manager role is regularly required to: Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull objects 25 pounds. Capability to stand and walk for up to 6 hours. Must be able to clearly communicate and quickly understand guests and associates’ directions in a loud environment. Be an ambassador of our Guiding Values and Behaviors by making people smile, learning and growing together, finding solutions and taking initiative, working (and winning) as a team, having fun and celebrating success, and seeing the best in others! __ Equal Opportunity Employer: Disabled/Veterans

title: Lead Bartender / Shift Lead $35–$45/hr
body:
**Norseman Distillery, Minneapolis**
Norseman Distillery is hiring an experienced Lead Bartender / Shift Lead for our cocktail room and private events.
**$20–$22/hour + pooled tips** 
**Approximately 30–36 hours per week** 
**Evening and weekend availability required**
This is a hands-on bartending position with added responsibility during service. It is not a salaried management job. You will still bartend, serve guests, work events, and participate in the tip pool while helping keep the room organized and the team moving.
We are a small cocktail room, and there are roughly 12–20 hours each week when strong leadership on the floor really matters: busy Friday and Saturday service, private events, cocktail classes, group reservations, and other high-volume periods.
We are looking for someone who can walk into those shifts, understand what is happening, make good decisions, communicate clearly, and help the entire team perform better.
The right person is calm under pressure, genuinely hospitable, organized, reliable, and comfortable taking responsibility without needing to dominate the room.
### You may be a good fit if you:
Have meaningful bartending, restaurant, taproom, brewery, distillery, or hospitality experience
Are comfortable leading a shift while still working alongside the team
Notice what needs to happen without waiting to be told
Can support and coach less experienced staff
Communicate clearly with guests, coworkers, and ownership
Handle guest issues professionally
Balance hospitality, speed, cleanliness, and sales
Enjoy private events and changing service environments
Are dependable and available for evenings and weekends
Want steady tipped hours rather than simply picking up an occasional shift
### Responsibilities
Bartend and support cocktail room service
Help lead the floor during assigned shifts
Keep service organized during busy periods
Manage guest flow, tabs, seating, and service pacing
Keep the bar clean, stocked, and organized
Support private events, cocktail classes, group reservations, and patio service
Complete opening and closing responsibilities
Help train and support newer team members
Communicate supply, staffing, and guest-service issues
Help make each shift more consistent and successful
### Schedule
Approximately 30–36 hours per week.
Our regular public hours are:
Tuesday: 4pm–9pm 
Wednesday: 4pm–9pm 
Thursday: 4pm–9pm 
Friday: 4pm–11pm 
Saturday: 12pm–11pm 
Sunday: 3pm–8pm 
Monday: Closed
The schedule can include cocktail room shifts, private events, cocktail classes, opening and closing, prep, and occasional event support outside normal public hours.
### Compensation
$20–$22/hour depending on experience
Plus pooled tips
Approximately 30–36 hours per week
Hourly tipped position, not salaried management
Private event and special-event opportunities
90-day check-in with the opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance
Reliability matters in a small team. Consistent attendance and dependable weekend availability are required.
To apply, send your resume, hospitality experience, and current availability. Please include a short note about why you are interested in taking a lead role in a small cocktail room.

title: Hiring PM Line Cooks
body:
Pink Ivy Kitchen and Bar is looking to add to our team of line cooks. 
We have five nights available, 3-10pm shifts. Sauté, Grill and Salad positions available.
We require advanced use of knife skills, recipe execution, and passion for serving others. We are a small, but mighty team that takes great pride in providing high-quality food in an exciting and energetic environment. 
We are looking for salad, sauté and grill cooks, who must have at least 3 years of experience in high-volume kitchens. Sunday and Monday nights are necessary.
We provide flexible shifts, competitive wages, a clean environment, and no late nights.
Chef Michael and his team work closely every day to execute the freshest and one of the most exciting menus in the city. We are looking for grill and saute cooks. We need highly dedicated people to grow our organization. If you love scratch cooking, a high-volume environment, and working with a passionate and talented team, apply today!
Responsibilities:
-Become part of a dynamic culinary team that pushes the boundries of american cuisine.
-Menu made from scratch cooking, no frozen or pre-made foods here.
-Rewarding opportunity to work with a talented chef and team of sous chefs. Lots of opportunity to learn and grow within a small organization.
- Prepare and cook food items according to recipes and quality standards
- Assist with food preparation and assembly as needed
- Follow proper food handling and safety procedures
- Maintain cleanliness and organization of the kitchen area
- Collaborate with the culinary team to ensure timely and efficient service
- Monitor food inventory and communicate any shortages or discrepancies
Skills:
- Previous experience in a food service or kitchen environment
- Knowledge of food safety and sanitation regulations
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting
- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow recipes accurately
- Excellent teamwork and communication skills
- Flexibility to work various shifts, including weekends and holidays
Note: This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employee may perform other related duties as assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization.

title: Restaurant Team Member
body:
Apply Now At Panera Bread, we believe every guest deserves our best. As a Restaurant Team Member , you’ll be the heart of hospitality- bringing warmth, care, and joy to every interaction. Restaurant Team Members have the special opportunity to connect with our amazing guests, directly impact the bakery-cafe’s growing business, and most importantly serve local communities across the country. Support in bringing Panera warmth to life and help ensure every guest receives our best. By sharing a warm welcome, delivering food with gratitude, always looking for ways to help, building personal connections, and finding moments to surprise and delight, you help create meaningful experiences that keep guests coming back. title: Team Manager
body:
Apply Now Lead with purpose. Grow with support. At Panera, our leaders are celebrated for bringing out the best in their teams. Enjoy great perks, a welcoming culture, and the opportunity to make a real impact—every day. Get ready to rise and come join the fun where you will be a part of making the familiar fantastic! Because at Panera, the best thing of bread is sharing it! What’s In It for You? Competitive pay & eligible for quarterly bonuses Free on-shift meals & unlimited fountain beverages Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, pet insurance & 401(k) with match available Career advancement & leadership development opportunities Tuition discounts Perks & rewards for team members Team member assistance program And much, much more! As a Team Manager, you’ll be part of the bakery-cafe’s leadership team, helping to run great shifts, support team development, and maintain the high standards our guests expect. As a Team Manager at Panera, Your Role Includes: Make sure every guest is delighted by the quality of our food, service, and staff. Build engaging relationships that lead to long-term, loyal guests. Lead, manager and develop team members by coaching, inspiring, and motivating them to exceed goals in sales, speed, order accuracy, and guest experience – and celebrate their achievements along the way. Participate in the interviewing and selection process. Train the team in food safety standards and ensure they are maintained. Help build our Culture of warmth, belonging, growth, and trust. This Opportunity Is for You If: Minimum age: 18 years of age. 1+ years of restaurant management experience preferred. Proven ability to lead great shifts while directing, motivating, coaching and developing others in a fast-paced environment. ServSafe certification (or ability to achieve certification). This role requires flexible hours including nights and weekends in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Any job offer for this position is conditional upon the results of a background check. While performing this job, the Team Manager role is regularly required to: Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull objects 25 pounds. Capability to stand and walk for up to 6 hours. Must be able to clearly communicate and quickly understand guests and associates’ directions in a loud environment. Be an ambassador of our Guiding Values and Behaviors by making people smile, learning and growing together, finding solutions and taking initiative, working (and winning) as a team, having fun and celebrating success, and seeing the best in others! __ Equal Opportunity Employer: Disabled/Veterans

title: Holiday Market Sales| $30-35/hr + Commission
body:
Can you talk to strangers all day and still have energy left at the end? Get paid well to do exactly that.
We're FIRMA, a family olive oil brand from Tunisia. Our family makes extremely special, organic olive oil, the kind people love the moment they taste it. Our whole job at the market is simple: get people to taste it, tell them what it is, and check them out.
We're hiring for our holiday markets in Minneapolis and St. Paul this season.
What you'll do:
Invite people passing by to taste our olive oil
Explain the product and our family story so people get curious and stay engaged
Check customers out
Keep your energy up and keep people engaged, all day, every day
Who we're looking for:
Someone who genuinely loves conversations and doesn't get drained by them
Someone who can be on their feet for a full outdoor market day and stay upbeat
Someone reliable and hungry to earn. There's a lot of commission on the table
No experience required. We train you
Pay: $30-35 per hour base, plus commission on every sale. Our best people earn up to $55 an hour. The more people you bring in to taste, the more you make.
Schedule: Minneapolis Christkindl Market (North Loop Green), 5 weekends, Friday through Sunday:
Fridays: market hours 4 pm to 9 pm. You arrive at 3 pm and stay until 10 pm
Saturdays: market hours 11 am to 9 pm. You arrive at 10 am and stay until 10 pm
Sundays: market hours 11 am to 7 pm. You arrive at 10 am and stay until 8 pm
Expected dates: [confirm 2026 dates: Nov 20-22, Nov 27-29, Dec 4-6, Dec 11-13, Dec 18-20 if it follows last year's pattern shifted by a day]
This is an outdoor market. Dress warm. It's Minnesota in winter
Requirement: You must commit to the full season. Please only apply if you can be there for every scheduled shift.
To apply: Send us your resume and a note on why you'll do well in this job. We get a lot of applicants, so tell us as much as you can about yourself and what makes you special for this role. The more we learn about you, the better your chances.

title: Toyota Lot Manager
body:
Apply Now For more than 70 years, Walser Automotive Group has put people first: our customers, our employees, and our communities. As a family-owned, family-run company, we've grown to 29 dealerships representing 26 brands across Minnesota, Kansas, and Illinois. 
 Walser Toyota has served the Twin Cities for more than 60 years and is the #1 volume Toyota dealership in the Upper Midwest — a ten-state region — three years running. With over a thousand new and pre-owned vehicles on the ground at any given time, the lot isn't a side function here. It's the operation. 
 A portion of every vehicle sold and serviced supports the Walser Foundation, investing in schools, nonprofits, and workforce programs in our communities. 
 The Role 
 You own the lot. More than a thousand vehicles, arriving, moving, staging, and leaving — and a team that makes it happen. This is a hands-on management job: you'll be outside with your team, and you'll also be the person accountable for accurate inventory records, clean transport damage reporting, and a department that shows up and performs. 
 The pace here is the job. Trucks arrive when they arrive. Sales needs a vehicle that's buried three rows back. A snow event rearranges your whole morning. We're looking for someone who has worked in that kind of environment before and is steady in it. 
 Retail background welcome — automotive background not required. If you've run a floor, a shift, or a back-of-house in high-volume retail, grocery, restaurant, or distribution, you already have the instincts this job needs. The dealership piece is teachable. The ability to keep a team moving when the plan changes at 10 AM is not. 
 Compensation:  $20-23/hr depending on experience! 
 What You'll Do 
 Lot & Vehicle Operations 
 Keep the dealership lot organized, presentable, and accurately merchandised at high inventory volume 
 Inspect new vehicles arriving on transport for damage; report transport and lot damage and arrange repairs 
 Maintain detail supplies inventory 
 Coordinate vehicle movement and staging so sales and service teams can find what they need, when they need it 
 Adjust staging and priorities as inventory, weather, and sales demand shift 
 Leading Your Team 
 Interview and hire in partnership with the Recruiting Department 
 Train staff on company policy and Walser service processes, and hold the standard 
 Manage schedules, pay rates, hours, and time off 
 Coach and monitor performance; deliver annual reviews with real, useful feedback 
 Handle disciplinary action and PIPs when needed; complete terminations with HR approval 
 Appraise productivity and recommend promotions and status changes 
 Address employee relations issues and escalate to HR when appropriate 
 Support your team's career development, lead by example, and advocate for your people 
 Communicate company news and support compliance and company initiatives 
 Uphold Walser's Core Values: Do The Right Thing, Lead By Example, Display Positive Energy, Be Open Minded. 
 What You Bring 
 At least 18 years of age 
 Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record 
 Experience in a fast-paced, high-volume environment — retail, grocery, restaurant, warehouse, or distribution 
 Comfortable shifting priorities mid-day and making decisions without perfect information 
 Ability to keep a team organized and steady through peak periods 
 Manual dexterity and eye/hand coordination to operate equipment 
 Helpful, not required: prior supervisory or keyholder experience, or exposure to dealership operations and DMS systems. 
 What the Job Is Actually Like 
 This is primarily outdoor work, year-round, in Minnesota weather. Expect walking, standing, bending, and moving vehicles for most of your shift. Volume is high and the day rarely goes exactly as planned. Safety eyewear is required at all times in dealership service departments. 
 What's In It For You 
 Paid Time Off (PTO) — time to relax, spend with family, or take personal time away
