 Walser Kia sits on Wayzata Boulevard in Minnetonka, serving Wayzata, Plymouth, and the western suburbs. It's a team doing things the Walser way: upfront pricing, one dedicated specialist, no runaround. 
 A portion of every vehicle sold and serviced supports the Walser Foundation, investing in schools, nonprofits, and workforce programs in our communities. 
 The Role 
 You own the lot. Every vehicle that arrives, moves, gets staged, or leaves Walser Kia passes through your process — and you lead the team that makes it happen. 
 The lot is the first thing a customer sees. How it looks and how it runs is a direct read on how the store runs, and that's on you. 
 This is a hands-on management job. You'll be outside with your team, and you'll also be the person accountable for accurate inventory records, clean transport damage reporting, and a department that shows up and performs. 
 No automotive background required. If you've led a team and kept a physical operation organized — retail, grocery, restaurant, warehouse, grounds, distribution — the dealership piece is teachable. What we can't teach is the instinct for keeping things moving when the plan changes. 
 Compensation: $20–$23 per hour (based on experience) 
 Schedule:  Monday-Friday: 8am-4pm 
 What You'll Do 
 Lot & Vehicle Operations 
 Keep the dealership lot organized, presentable, and accurately merchandised 
 Inspect new vehicles arriving on transport for damage; report transport and lot damage and arrange repairs 
 Maintain detail supplies inventory 
 Coordinate vehicle movement and staging so sales and service teams can find what they need, when they need it 
 Keep the lot's daily processes running and adjust them as volume shifts 
 Inventory & Administration 
 Enter vehicles into the DMS and keep records accurate 
 Scan and file invoices for all new vehicles 
 Process dealer trade paperwork 
 Enter price changes, audit sales and RDRs 
 Build packets and assign stock numbers for incoming vehicles 
 Leading Your Team 
 Interview and hire in partnership with the Recruiting Department 
 Train staff on company policy and Walser service processes, and hold the standard 
 Manage schedules, pay rates, hours, and time off 
 Coach and monitor performance; deliver annual reviews with real, useful feedback 
 Handle disciplinary action and PIPs when needed; complete terminations with HR approval 
 Appraise productivity and recommend promotions and status changes 
 Address employee relations issues and escalate to HR when appropriate 
 Support your team's career development, lead by example, and advocate for your people 
 Communicate company news and support compliance and company initiatives 
 Uphold Walser's Core Values: Do The Right Thing, Lead By Example, Display Positive Energy, Be Open Minded. 
 What You Bring 
 At least 18 years of age 
 Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record 
 Experience keeping a physical operation organized — retail, restaurant, warehouse, grounds, or similar 
 Comfortable making decisions and adjusting when the day doesn't go as planned 
 Ability to keep a team organized and steady through busy stretches 
 Manual dexterity and eye/hand coordination to operate equipment 
 Helpful, not required: prior supervisory or keyholder experience, or exposure to dealership operations and DMS systems. 
 What the Job Is Actually Like 
 This is primarily outdoor work, year-round, in Minnesota weather. Expect walking, standing, bending, and moving vehicles for most of your shift. The day rarely goes exactly as planned. Safety eyewear is required at all times in dealership service departments. 
 What's In It For You 
 Paid Time Off (PTO) — time to relax, spend with family, or take personal time away 
 Career growth and advancement — we promote from within, with clear career paths and mentorship 
 Comprehensive health benefits — Blue Cross Blue Shield medical, dental, and vision, plus HSA and FSA options and additional wellness benefits 
 Life insurance and 401(k) with employer match — company-paid life insurance and a matched retirement program 
 Fertility and adoption assistance — up to $10,000 in financial assistance 
 Employee discounts across products and services 
 Employee Resource Groups — Women of Walser, Drive with Pride, Asian Hmong Alliance, and Veterans at Walser 
 Community involvement — volunteer through the Walser Foundation 
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) — support for personal and professional challenges 
 Referral Program — earn bonuses for referring talented candidates

title: ALDI - Full-Time Store Associate
body:
Apply Now 
As a store associate, you’ll be responsible for merchandising and stocking product, cashiering, and cleaning to keep the store looking its best. You’ll enhance the customer shopping experience by working collaboratively with the ALDI team and providing exceptional customer service.
Position Type: Full-Time
Average Hours: 30+ hours per week
Starting Wage: $20.00 per hour
Wage Increases: Year 2 - $20.50 | Year 3 - $21.00 | Year 4 - $21.00 | Year 5 - $22.00
Duties and Responsibilities:
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Models and fulfills all customer service principles and escalates concerns to store management as necessary.
• Informs store management of loss due to outdated or damaged products.
• Properly utilizes the point-of-sale (POS) system to accurately scan and process customer purchases and informs store management of scanning concerns or errors.
• Adheres to cash policies and procedures.
• Follows the line policy and opens additional check lanes as required to ensure an efficient checkout.
• Stocks shelves and displays neatly while following merchandising planograms to maximize sales.
• Complete curbside pickup orders by accurately retrieving items from the store, verifying order contents, and ensuring timely delivery to customers’ vehicles from the staging area.
• Maintains zone standards and merchandising standards at all times.
• Assists store management in achieving operational efficiency goals.
• Assists store management in achieving total loss goals.
• Complies with all established company policies and processes.
• Supports store management in providing a safe working environment by identifying and rectifying hazards, ensuring proper ergonomics, and maintaining equipment in proper working order.
• Adheres to inventory procedures and product handling guidelines.
• Performs general cleaning tasks to company standards.
Physical Demands:
• Required to push, pull, sit, stand, reach, grasp, twist, bend, and move from one area to another.
• Required to lift, carry, and place product weighing up to 45 pounds on shelves at various heights, including overhead.
• Required to operate equipment such as a cash register, electric and manual hand jacks, floor scrubber and cardboard baler.
• Required to stock product in varying temperatures, including freezer and cooler environments.
• Required to use glass and multipurpose cleaning products.
Qualifications:
• Ability to provide prompt and courteous customer service.
• Ability to operate all store equipment such as cash registers, floor scrubber, cardboard baler, pallet jacks, handheld devices, computers, etc.
• Ability to interpret and apply ALDI operating policies and procedures.
• Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing.
• Ability to perform basic arithmetic such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
• Ability to follow instructions and pay attention to detail.
• Ability to work both independently and with others.
• Ability to organize, prioritize and complete assigned tasks to maximize productivity within established timeframes.
• Ability to maintain reliable and prompt attendance.
• Ability to meet availability requirements.
Education and Experience:
• At least 18 years old required.
• High school diploma or equivalent preferred.
• Prior work experience in a retail environment preferred.
ALDI offers competitive wages and benefits, to all employees including:
401(k) Plan
Company 401(k) Matching Contributions
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
PerkSpot National Discount Program
In addition, full-time employees are offered:
Medical, Prescription, Dental & Vision Insurance
Generous Vacation Time & 7 Paid Holidays
Up to 6 Weeks Paid Parental Leave at 100% of pay
Up to 2 Weeks Paid Caregiver Leave at 100% of pay
Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Life, Dependent Life and AD&D Insurance
Voluntary Term Life Insurance
*Full-time employees average 30 or more hours per week within an annual lookback period
**Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by state
ALDI is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. As a proud Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE), we do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, religion, sex, sexual stereotyping, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), or any other protected characteristic. Employment may be contingent upon ALDI's receipt of an acceptable and job-related drug test, motor vehicle report, and/or reference check, as applicable and permissible by law.

title: Bloomington Toyota Bilingual Sales Consultant(Hmong, Spanish, Somal...
body:
Apply Now Position Overview 
 Never sold a car in your life? Good. We are not looking for a resume full of dealership jobs. We are looking for people who can connect with our customers in the language they are most comfortable speaking. If you can do that, we will teach you everything else - through three and a half weeks of hands-on training, fully paid, before you ever work a deal on your own. 
 Buying a car is one of the biggest decisions a family makes, and it should not be harder because of the language you speak at home. Our customers come from every corner of the Twin Cities, and we want every one of them to be able to ask questions, understand the numbers, and sign the paperwork in the language they think in. That is the job. Your language is not a bonus skill here - it is the qualification. 
 Compensation and Schedule 
 Base pay plus uncapped commission - your effort sets the ceiling, not a pay grade 
 Average earnings of $75,000-$120,000 per year; top performers exceed $150,000 
 You earn while you learn - training is fully paid from day one 
 Four-day workweek - full-time pay and benefits, three days off 
 Responsibilities 
 Greet every customer promptly and courteously, and serve bilingual customers in their preferred language 
 Guide customers through the full sales process, start to finish 
 Take customers on test drives and walk them through how the vehicle works 
 Explain financing and protection options clearly, so nothing is a surprise at signing 
 Track every customer interaction in the Walser CRM 
 Follow up after the sale - the relationship does not end at the keys 
 Meet the unit average, PVR, and VSC expectations set by your store 
 Uphold Walser's Core Values: Do The Right Thing, Lead By Example, Display Positive Energy, Be Open Minded 
 All other duties, tasks, and projects as assigned 
 Qualifications 
 No dealership experience. No degree. No sales background. If you have worked retail, restaurants, warehouse, healthcare, rideshare, or nothing at all yet, you can do this job. Many of our strongest consultants started with none of it. 
 Conversational fluency in Hmong, Spanish, or Somali, along with English, so you can guide a customer through a purchase in either language 
 At least 18 years of age 
 A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record 
 Genuine listening skills - the ability to hear what someone actually needs 
 Comfort with a phone, a computer, and learning new software (we will train you on our systems) 
 A friendly, positive attitude and a team-first mindset 
 Willingness to complete and pass our paid sales training program 
 Professional demeanor and appearance 
 Benefits 
 Paid Training: three and a half weeks of in-depth, hands-on training, fully paid, to build real confidence before you are on your own 
 Four-Day Work Weeks: longer weekends without giving up full-time benefits 
 Paid Time Off: time to rest, travel, or be with family 
 Career Growth: we promote from within, with clear paths and mentorship 
 Comprehensive Health Benefits: medical, dental, and vision through Blue Cross Blue Shield, plus HSA and FSA options 
 Life Insurance and 401(k) with Employer Match 
 Fertility and Adoption Assistance: up to $10,000 in support 
 Paid Clothing Program: twice a year, choose from curated Walser apparel, on us 
 Employee Discounts across products and services 
 Employee Resource Groups: Women of Walser, Drive with Pride, Asian Hmong Alliance, and Veterans at Walser 
 Community Involvement: volunteer through the Walser Foundation 
 Employee Assistance Program for personal and professional support 
 Referral Program: earn bonuses for bringing in great people 
 Working Conditions 
 Safety eyewear is required at all times in dealership service departments 
 Hard-toed, slip-resistant footwear is required in dealership service departments 
 About Walser Automotive Group 
 For more than 70 years, Walser Automotive Group has put people first: our customers, our employees, and our communities. As a family-owned, family-run company, we have grown to 29 dealerships representing 26 brands across Minnesota, Kansas, and Illinois. We lead with innovation, technology, and a promise to deliver an exceptional experience every time. Your work here matters - a portion of every vehicle sold and serviced supports the Walser Foundation, investing in schools, nonprofits, and workforce programs in our communities. 
 Apply today - bring your language, we'll bring the training. Bilingual Hmong, Spanish, and Somali speakers are encouraged to apply. 
 Equal Employment Opportunity

title: CDS Full Time Event Manager - Product Demonstration
body: Apply Now CDS Full Time Event Manager - Product Demonstration   Club Demonstration Services (CDS) is in need of an Event Manager responsible for the recruitment, hiring and supervision of in store Product Demonstrators. You will oversee product preparation and presentation, training and provide superb service to all Club members. This position requires strong communication between warehouse managers, vendors and in store Product Demonstrators including participation in new location grand openings.   CDS is the preferred in-house event marketing provider to Costco. We offer the best person-to-person marketing services in the industry, driving sales for our customers and Costco. APPLY TODAY!   What We Offer: Set schedule of Tuesday-Saturday from 8:30AM – 5:30PM (may vary based on needs) Work-life balance! Full Time Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life) Short and Long-Term Disability 401(K) plan Generous paid time off Responsibilities: Recruit, train and hire part-time staff. Oversee product preparation and presentation, including food safety and sanitation. Train Product Demonstrators in demonstration preparation and excellent customer services. Communicate between multiple manager, vendors and demonstrators. Participate in new location grand openings as required. Requirements: High school education or equivalent. Two to four years of related experience in retail, hospitality, or food environments. Detail oriented with excellent leadership and communication skills. Proven ability to lead well performing teams. Ability to exercise independent judgement. Able to coach and counsel employees, take correct measures as needs. Flexibility and ability to work in a fast paced environment   Job Will Remain Open Until Filled Apply Now

title: shift supervisor - Store# 00274, 50TH & FRANCE
body:
Apply Now Crafting the world’s finest coffee, one meaningful moment at a time We believe in creating a warm and welcoming space where every cup of coffee sparks connection. Every shift is a chance to brighten someone’s day. As a shift supervisor you will lead with craft and heart to make your coffeehouse a welcoming space for your community. 
 We are invested in your growth journey, empowered through developmental experiences as well our industry leading benefits . 
 Basic Qualifications Maintain regular and consistent attendance and punctuality, with or without reasonable accommodation Available to work flexible hours that may include early mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and/or holidays Meet store operating policies and standards, including providing quality beverages and food products, cash handling and store safety and security, with or without reasonable accommodations Six (6) months of experience in a position that required constant interacting with and fulfilling the requests of customers  Prepare and coach the preparation of food and beverages to standard recipes or customized for customers, including recipe changes such as temperature, quantity of ingredients or substituted ingredients At least six (6) months of experience delegating tasks to other employees and/or coordinating the tasks of two (2) or more employees Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Ability to direct the work of others Ability to learn quickly Effective oral communication skills Knowledge of the retail environment Strong interpersonal skills Ability to work as part of a team Ability to build relationships       As a Starbucks partner, you (and your family) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, and other voluntary insurance benefits.  Partners have access to short-term and long-term disability, paid parental leave, family expansion reimbursement, paid vacation that accrues starting at .01961 hours based on a 40 hour week up to 40 hours annually ( 64 hours in California) after an introductory period, sick time (accrued at 1 hour for every 25 or 30 hours worked, depending on work location), and additional pay if working on one of eight observed holidays. Starbucks also offers eligible partners participation in a 401(k)-retirement plan with employer match, a discounted company stock program (S.I.P.), Starbucks equity program (Bean Stock), a quarterly bonus opportunity, incentivized emergency savings, and financial well-being tools.  Additionally, Starbucks offers 100% upfront tuition coverage for a first-time bachelor’s degree through Arizona State University’s online program via the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, student loan management resources, and access to other educational opportunities. You will also have access to backup care and DACA reimbursement. Starbucks will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. This list is subject to change depending on collective bargaining in locations where partners have a certified bargaining representative.   For additional information regarding partner perks and more detailed information regarding benefits, go to starbucksbenefits.com .      At Starbucks, it is typical for new partners to be hired at the entry point of the range for their role, which is based upon geographic location. Individual compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.     Starbucks Coffee Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances. Starbucks Coffee Company is committed to offering reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at applicantaccommodation@starbucks.com or 1(888) 611-2258. Apply Now

title: Toyota Sales Loyalty Manager (2 Yrs Dealership Exp. Required)
body:
Apply Now Loyalty Manager– Walser Toyota 
 Love Sales—but Even Better at Building Relationships? 
 What if your next sales opportunity started with customers who already know us? 
 At Walser Toyota Bloomington , we’re looking for a Loyalty Specialist to connect with our existing sales and service customers, identify opportunities to upgrade or trade their vehicles, and help turn long-term relationships into their next Toyota. 
 This is a unique automotive sales opportunity that combines relationship-building, sales, technology, customer retention, and vehicle acquisition —all within one of the highest-volume Toyota operations in the country. 
 And with 7,000+ vehicles sold annually for the past seven years , you’ll have something incredibly valuable to work with: a large, established customer base and a steady flow of opportunities. 
 Why Walser Toyota Bloomington? 
 You’ll be joining a Toyota operation with a track record of sustained performance and customer loyalty: 
 7,000+ vehicles sold annually for the past 7 consecutive years 
 Toyota Board of Governors Award Winner – 3 consecutive years (2023, 2024 & 2025) 
 President’s Award for Customer First – 7 consecutive years 
 Customer First Advisory Board Winner – recognizing the Top 50 Toyota dealerships nationally for excellence in service, parts, and customer satisfaction 
 World-class, state-of-the-art facility 
 Prime Bloomington location in the center of the Twin Cities 
 An established base of Toyota sales and service customers to build relationships with 
 You’ll be part of Walser Automotive Group’s largest operation , representing one of the most recognized automotive brands in the world— Toyota . 
 Compensation:  Target Annual Earnings: $60,000–$100,000+ 
 Compensation includes a $5,000 monthly draw , plus additional earnings driven by your sales results. 
 Your ability to build relationships, uncover opportunities, and generate vehicle sales directly impacts your earning potential. 
 Who This Role Is Perfect For 
 This opportunity is ideal for someone who is sales-minded, relationship-driven, organized, and motivated by results. 
 You may be a: 
 Current Automotive Sales Professional who excels at repeat and referral business 
 Business Development or BDC Professional ready for a more sales-focused opportunity 
 Customer Service Professional with strong sales instincts and relationship-building skills 
 Automotive Professional who understands CRM, equity, trade values, or customer retention 
 Consultative Sales Professional who enjoys helping customers understand when it may make sense to upgrade 
 You don't have to be someone who loves waiting for the next customer to walk through the showroom doors.  You create your own opportunities. 
 What You’ll Do 
 As a Loyalty Specialist, you’ll connect the dots between our service drive, customer database, current vehicle market, and sales operation to identify customers who may be ready for their next vehicle. 
 Turn Service Visits Into Sales Opportunities 
 Review upcoming service appointments to identify potential upgrade and trade opportunities 
 Compare service customers with our CRM and existing customer database 
 Connect with customers whose current vehicle, equity position, lease status, or ownership cycle may create an opportunity 
 Partner closely with our Service and Sales teams to provide a seamless customer experience 
 Help turn everyday dealership visits into long-term customer relationships and incremental vehicle sales 
 Build & Maintain Your Customer Pipeline 
 Reconnect with previous sales customers and current service guests through proactive outbound communication 
 Educate customers on potential trade, lease return, buyout, and upgrade opportunities 
 Schedule dealership appointments and maintain consistent follow-up 
 Build relationships that encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty 
 Track customer activity and opportunities within dealership systems 
 Use Data to Find the Right Opportunity 
 Utilize AutoAlert and CRM technology to identify customers with potential equity or vehicle replacement opportunities 
 Calculate potential lease returns and buyouts using current OEM programs 
 Estimate trade values and potential monthly payment scenarios 
 Maintain and optimize AutoAlert presets 
 Monitor your pipeline and prioritize the customers most likely to benefit from a conversation 
 Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly activity and performance reporting 
 Create a Consultative Customer Experience 
 This isn't about simply telling someone it's time to buy another vehicle. 
 You'll help customers understand their options. 
 Discuss potential trade and upgrade scenarios 
 Educate customers on available financing and financial products 
 Help customers understand how their current vehicle's value could impact their next purchase 
 Provide a personalized experience based on each customer's needs and ownership situation 
 Partner with dealership leadership to focus outreach and campaigns around current business opportunities 
 What You Bring 
 Prior automotive sales or business development experience strongly preferred 
 Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required 
 Strong sales instincts and a genuine customer-service mentality 
 Confidence communicating with customers by phone, digitally, and in person 
 Familiarity with CRM technology; automotive CRM experience preferred 
 Strong mathematical and analytical skills 
 Ability to understand vehicle values, payments, lease scenarios, and customer equity 
 Excellent organization and follow-through 
 Ability to manage multiple customers and opportunities simultaneously 
 Self-motivated mindset with the ability to work independently 
 Intermediate computer skills, including Word, Excel, and Outlook 
 Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record

 Paid Time Off (PTO) – Take time to relax, spend with family, or enjoy personal time away

title: Retail Mobile Sales Associate
body:
Full-Time or Part-Time | Onsite | Bilingual in English and Spanish a plus!
Join 2020 Mobile Corp, a Boost Mobile Platinum Retailer!
Love smartphones, tech, and helping people stay connected? Want a job that builds real-world skills, pays you while you learn, and lets your personality shine?
We’re looking for outgoing, motivated Retail Mobile Sales Associates to join our team. No wireless experience? No problem — we train you from day one.
•••
Easy ways to apply!
- Apply online at 2020mobilecorp.com/careers
- Reply to this email with your resume attached.
- Drop off your resume at one of our locations.
•••
What You’ll Be Doing: 
As a Mobile Sales Associate, you’ll be the face of 2020 Mobile Corp (Boost Mobile Retailer) in our store — helping customers find the right plans, phones, and accessories to match their lives. We believe a positive attitude, teamwork, and a little fun make the workday better—for us and for our customers.
You’ll:
• Create great customer experiences with a friendly, service-first approach
• Talk tech, explain plans, and recommend solutions that make sense
• Help bring in new customers and build relationships with returning ones
• Stay up to date on phones, pricing, and promotions (and upsell when it fits!)
• Answer store phone calls and customer questions
• Work toward daily, weekly, and monthly sales goals
• Participate in local marketing and special events
• Keep the store clean, organized, and ready for business
• Use sales systems and follow company policies
• Collaborate with teammates and managers
• Jump in on additional tasks or projects as needed
What Makes You a Great Fit:
• Strong communication skills (written & verbal)
• A positive, professional, can-do attitude
• The ability to multitask, problem-solve, and stay organized
• Previous experience in wireless or retail sales (a plus, not required!)
What You’ll Need:
• Must be 18 years or older
• 6+ months of customer service and/or retail sales experience
• Basic experience using computers and mobile phones
• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information
• Legally authorized to work in the United States
• High school diploma or GED
• Spanish bilingual skills preferred in some locations
Physical Requirements:
• Ability to stand for long periods on the sales floor
• Ability to lift and/or move up to 15 pounds
• Frequent standing, walking, talking, hearing, and use of hands/fingers
• Occasional reaching, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching
• Ability to perform repetitive motions (including overhead reaching and typing)
Compensation:
• $13.00 - $15.00 per hour DOE. The base pay does not factor in an aggressive commission program when goals and objectives are met. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.
• Health Benefits: The company offers Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance programs for Full-Time employees.
• Earned Sick Leave
• Employee Discounts: Phone devices and Accessories
More About Our Company:
2020 Mobile Corp is one of the largest Platinum Branded Partner for Boost Mobile with over 200 locations nationwide and growing. 2020 Mobile Corp was founded with a revolutionary spirit and uncommon fondness for the wireless retail industry. Our goal is simple: to offer our customers exceptional service by ensuring our employees work in a career and for a company they love. We believe that when our employees are happy with what they do, the support and satisfaction they receive is passed on to our customers. Learn more and view privacy policies at www.2020mobilecorp.com.
2020 Mobile Corp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to providing equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all candidates, without discrimination based on race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Following the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, all new hires must verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States.
Note: This job ad/description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may perform other related duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. 
2020 Mobile Corp does not sponsor employment-based visas. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Assistant Manager
body:
Apply Now 
 JOB LOCATION: 3230 Southdale Cir, Edina, MN, 55435
 ALL ROADS LEAD TO THIS OPPORTUNITY
 The journey to Valvoline Instant Oil Change (VIOC) is different for everyone. Our employees are students, recent grads, parents, part-time workers, veterans, career changerswho have all found their way to our team. No matter where youve been or what youre looking for, discover how your road leads to Valvoline.
 ROLE OVERVIEW: What youll do to drive success
 When you join us as an Assistant Service Center Manager , you are the right hand of the Service Center Manager. You are responsible for taking the lead in helping build a high-performance team capable of differentiating Valvoline Instant Oil Changes (VIOC) service experience from all other providers. In addition to working on cars and taking care of our guests, you will advise, train, and supervise hourly employees and ensure company policies and procedures are executed consistently. Youll be expected to:
 Perform oil changes and additional car maintenance services, educate guests on vehicle maintenance requirements and ensure that recommended services are reviewed
 While working on the floor, supervise daily operations of the service center and train new team members
 Build trust and win repeat, loyal customers by working with your team to ensure excellent customer service through Valvolines quick, easy, trusted process
 Develop and maintain efficient weekly work schedules for employees, ensuring optimal coverage, managing schedule conflicts and following labor laws
 Assist with inventory process, ensuring appropriate product levels and scheduling orders
 Assist with store audits (ex. Safety, performance, culture). Help maintain a clean, well-organized service center and facilitate a safe and secure working environment
 Open and close the service center, ensuring all safety and security protocols are followed
 Lead, and train the team to optimize their development
 BENEFITS: What youll gain to fuel your goals
 Were committed to putting our people first in every way possible. Thats why we offer a variety of benefits* to help you navigate and advance a better future.
 Heres a look at some of our unique benefits:
 Compensation: Weekly pay of $22.75 per hour
 Career Acceleration: Hands-on training for the potential to become a Service Center Manager within 12 months.
 Debt-Free Education: 13 paid credit hours / year a t WilmU, covering part-time enrollment over two semesters, and access to a free online university.
 Life Balance: No late-night hours, holidays off, paid time-off availability, and back-up child and elder care.
 Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision , plus prescription drug coverage with Health Savings Account contributions.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Quick, free, and confidential well-being support for all areas of life, including personal and work relationships, family, mental health, and legal issues.
 Employee Perks: Company-provided uniforms and tools, 50% discount on VIOC automotive services, and 401(k) savings plans with a 100% match up to 5%.
 QUALIFICATIONS: What youll need to keep moving forward
 From day one, youll get the hands-on training and support you need to thrive as an Assistant Service Center Manager. All you need to do is bring your positive attitude, attention to detail, and passion for learningand well help you every step of the way.
 We seek team members with:
 1 year of supervisory experience required (coaching, training, and supervising a team), preferably in a retail or service-related environment
 Customer service mindset and demonstrated ability to build loyalty while following company procedures
 Experience in a fast-paced environment and history of making sound judgements under pressure
 Experience using KPI data to monitor performance, trends, and identify areas for improvement
 Schedule flexibility (Weekend availability is likely, but we ensure you dont work late nights or holidays)
 English fluency in reading, writing, and speaking
 High School Diploma or equivalent
 We expect you can:
 Stand for up to 8 hours, climb stairs, and occasionally lift up to 50 pounds
 Crouch, bend, twist, and work with your hands above your head

title: ALDI - Full-Time Assistant Store Manager
body:
National Hiring Week is coming to ALDI. That means a big opportunity for you to jump in on our recently announced wages, best-in-class benefits and room to grow in your career! National Hiring Week runs from September 14 to 20 — apply online today and you may qualify to join in on our rapid growth.
When you join our team as an Assistant Store Manager, you’ll take on key store management responsibilities including assisting with supervising day-to-day store activities, ensuring overall store performance, managing schedules, and developing operational action plans while identifying training opportunities to develop and grow the team.
Position Type: Full-Time
Average Hours: 38 hours per week
Starting Wage: $27.00 per hour
Wage Increase: Year 2 - $28.00 per hour
Duties and Responsibilities:
Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation
• Assists the direct leader with developing and implementing action plans to improve operating results
• Establishes and communicates job responsibilities and performance expectations to their direct reports to ensure mutual understanding and desired results
• Identifies training and development opportunities that will assist their direct reports in achieving enhanced performance
• Understands the overarching company strategy, as well as communicates and models the core values of the organization, to create a sense of teamwork and membership among employees
• Monitors the competitive environment within the community and informs the direct leader regarding adjustments necessary to maintain the company’s competitive position
• Provides product feedback to the direct leader, including making recommendations regarding new items to carry or those that should be discontinued
• Participates in the interviewing process for store personnel
• Communicates information including weekly information, major team milestones, developments, and concerns
• Ensures store personnel adhere to inventory procedures, product handling guidelines, and cash control policies to minimize losses
• Ensures an appropriate resolution of operational customer concerns in their direct leader’s absence
• Identifies and rectifies hazards, ensuring proper ergonomics and maintaining store equipment in proper working order
• Maintains store cleanliness standards and proper store signage at all times
• Assists the direct leader with maintaining proper stock levels through appropriate product ordering
• Merchandises product neatly to maximize sales
• Ensures the quality and freshness of products for sale and accuracy of product signage
• Assists their direct leader with achieving the store payroll and total loss budget, inventory counts, and training new employees
• Supervises the day-to-day operations of their team, escalating issues to the appropriate level of support and/or leadership when necessary
• Ensures direct reports complete assigned responsibilities in a timely and effective manner to provide the highest level of customer service for the business
• Complies with all established company policies and procedures while upholding the security and confidentiality of documents and data
• Other duties as assigned
Physical Demands:
• Ability to stock merchandise from store receiving to shelving; ability to place product, weighing up to 45 pounds, on shelving at various heights
• Regularly required to sit, stand, bend, reach, push, pull, lift, carry, and walk about the store
• Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodations
Job Qualifications:
• You must be 18 years of age or older to be employed for this role at ALDI
• Ability to work both independently and within a team environment
• Ability to provide and lead others to provide prompt and courteous customer service
• Ability to develop rapport, trust, and open communication that enhances the growth and job performance of direct reports
• Ability to interpret and apply company policies and procedures
• Ability to establish goals, guide employee performance to ensure the quality and completion of work assignments
• Ability to evaluate and drive performance of self and others
• Ability to understand and apply management principles concerning budgeting, personnel costs, and expenses
• Ability to operate a cash register efficiently and accurately
• Ability to safely and properly operate equipment, including electric/manual hand jack, floor scrubber, and cardboard baler and perform general cleaning duties to company standards
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to stay organized and multi-task in a professional and efficient manner, following instructions and giving attention to detail
• Meets any state and local requirements for handling and selling alcoholic beverages
Education and Experience:
• High School Diploma or equivalent preferred
• A minimum of 3 years of progressive experience in a retail environment
• A combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge
• Prior management experience preferred
ALDI offers competitive wages and benefits, to all employees including:
401(k) Plan
Company 401(k) Matching Contributions
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
PerkSpot National Discount Program
In addition, full-time employees are offered:
Medical, Prescription, Dental & Vision Insurance
Generous Vacation Time & 7 Paid Holidays
Up to 6 Weeks Paid Parental Leave at 100% of pay
Up to 2 Weeks Paid Caregiver Leave at 100% of pay
Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
Life, Dependent Life and AD&D Insurance
Voluntary Term Life Insurance
*Full-time employees average 30 or more hours per week within an annual lookback period
**Benefits offered to full-time and part-time employees may vary by state

Low Voltage Technician
 TThe purpose of this position is to install, service, and test electronic security systems including burglar and fire alarms, CCTV, Access Control systems and all related electronic security equipment in residential, commercial, and industrial environments. title: Independent Living Skills Coach
body:
Apply Now SpringPath Mental Health Services, a part of the Sevita family, provides behavioral health services through Intensive Residential Treatment, Assertive Community Treatment, and Targeted Case Management programs. We embrace a person-centered approach that is trauma informed, culturally responsive, and recovery-oriented. Our dedicated team supports individuals with mental health, psychiatric, or other complex needs to overcome challenges, build skills, and live a full, meaningful life. 
 SUMMARY 
 The ILS/MHW works as part of an Intensive Residential Treatment Services team that provides care, treatment and rehabilitation for persons served who are experiencing significant mental health/psychiatric symptoms; who are demonstrating significant functional impairments; and who may have co-occurring disorders. 
 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS 
 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below.   
 Provides assistance to person(s) served in order to promote their physical, social, and psychological well-being. 
 Interacts frequently and positively with person(s) served and support staff to promote the rights of the person(s) served to achieve an enhanced quality of life. 
 Assist Psychiatric Rehabilitation Practitioners with requested needs. 
 Follow agency procedures to promote optimum health care, safety practice and behavioral supports to maintain the well-being of person(s) served. 
 Administrative duties (scanning, faxing, organizing). 
 Oversees meal preparation and grocery shopping. 
 Cleaning. 
 Transport Clients. 
 Managing food/cleaning budget. 
 Provide group and individual services for clients. 
 Teach clients independent living skills. 
 Develop and maintain a cooperative working relationship with various teams. 
 Provide the necessary financial management for the day-to-day operations of the program using established practices and procedures. 
 Ensure compliance with training licensing regulations and company policies and procedures. 
 Medication Administration and monitoring. 
 Maintain clean and safe work environment. 
 Manages the day to day therapeutic environment including the prevention of crisis at the lowest level of escalation. 
 Develops and participates in community and in-house recreational and leisure activities. 
 Completes all documentation. 
 SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 None 
 Minimum Knowledge and Skills required for the Job 
 The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or abilities required to perform the job. 
 Education and Experience:  
 GED or High School Diploma with 2,000 supervised hours in the delivery of services to adults with serious mental illness. 
 Bachelor's degree preferred in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college or university. 
 Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations: 
 N/A. 
 Other Skills and Abilities: 
 N/A. 
 Other Requirements: 
 Travel as needed. 
 Physical Requirements: 
 Heavy work: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.  
 Pay Rate: $22-23 
 Sevita is a leading provider of home and community-based specialized health care. We believe that everyone deserves to live a full, more independent life. We provide people with quality services and individualized supports that lead to growth and independence, regardless of the physical, intellectual, or behavioral challenges they face. 
We’ve made this our mission for more than 50 years. And today, our 40,000 team members continue to innovate and enhance care for the 50,000 individuals we serve all over the U.S.

body:
Part-Time Guest Services Associate
Nedia Hair Loss Salon, Plymouth
Job Type: Part-Time
Schedule: Fridays and Saturdays Ideal 
About Us
We are a welcoming salon specializing in healthy hair, hair restoration, and exceptional guest experiences. Our mission is to help every guest feel confident, cared for, and valued from the moment they walk through our doors. We're looking for a friendly, organized, and dependable Guest Services Associate to join our team.
Position Summary
As the first point of contact for our guests, you'll create a warm, professional, and memorable experience while managing front desk operations. You'll assist with scheduling, guest communication, retail sales, and ensuring the salon runs smoothly each day.
Responsibilities
 Welcome every guest with warmth, professionalism, and genuine hospitality.
 Answer phone calls, emails, and text messages promptly and courteously.
 Schedule, confirm, and manage guest appointments.
 Check guests in and out using the salon management system.
 Process payments and maintain accurate records.
 Educate guests about salon services, products, and promotions.
 Keep the reception area clean, organized, and inviting.
 Assist the salon team with administrative tasks as needed.
 Help create an exceptional guest experience during every visit.
Qualifications
 Previous customer service, front desk, receptionist, retail, or hospitality experience preferred.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

body:

Residential Services, Inc. (RSI) is seeking a full-time Maintenance Technician to perform maintenance and repair work at RSI buildings, grounds, and residential homes throughout East Central Minnesota. This position will provide maintenance support to RSI locations in North Branch, Mora, Cambridge, Princeton, Taylors Falls, Sandstone, and surrounding communities.
The typical schedule is Monday through Friday business hours, with occasional paid call-in shifts during evenings, nights, and weekends. Depending on operational needs, the position may have the flexibility to work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts.
Wage: $20.00-$21.00 based on experience
Job Duties:
-Perform maintenance and repairs at RSI residential homes, offices, and other facilities, including painting, floor care, electrical and plumbing repairs, appliance installation and repair, fixture replacement, caulking, and other general maintenance tasks.
-Refurbish and maintain resident living areas and RSI facilities, including painting, assembling furniture, repairing holes and wall damage, replacing damaged or broken fixtures, and assisting with resident moves and related maintenance needs.
-Assess and diagnose maintenance issues and determine appropriate repair solutions.
-Perform routine building maintenance and basic troubleshooting of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other building systems and equipment.
-Receive and respond to maintenance requests from RSI staff through the online ticketing system and other communication methods.
-Prioritize maintenance needs and projects based on urgency and operational needs and maintain accurate and timely status updates in RSI’s tracking system.
-Coordinate building, facility, and contracted repairs with approved vendors and serve as a point of contact for vendor services.
-Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on RSI vehicles and coordinate scheduled maintenance and repairs with approved vendors.
-Maintain sidewalks, driveways, and other exterior areas by sweeping, shoveling, and removing obstructions as needed.
-Ensure proper removal and disposal of debris from buildings and grounds.
-Perform landscaping and grounds maintenance, including mowing, raking, trimming, watering, and other related tasks.
-Establish and maintain effective working relationships with people receiving services, staff, vendors, and others contacted in the course of daily work.
-Other duties as assigned.
Requirements: 
Minimum of two years of hands-on maintenance experience, including the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of building mechanical systems such as HVAC, plumbing, and electrical systems. Experience coordinating and implementing capital improvement projects. All candidates must have a valid driver's license, meet company motor vehicle operator criteria, and successfully complete a background check.
Preferred Experience:
1 - 2 yrs. hotel, hospital, or assisted living facility maintenance experience. Experience working independently with little or no supervision preferred.
Physical Requirements:
-Lifting, pushing, or pulling up to 80 pounds using proper body mechanics and/or available equipment.
-Bending, kneeling, climbing ladders, and performing other physical activities necessary to complete maintenance tasks.
-Standing and walking for extended periods and climbing stairs.
-Working outdoors in varying and potentially extreme weather conditions, including winter and summer temperatures.

-Operating standard office equipment, including computers.

A Maintenance Technician in property management is responsible for performing a variety of repairs and maintenance tasks across residential or commercial properties, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general upkeep, responding to resident/tenant service requests, and ensuring the overall functionality and appearance of the property by completing routine inspections and preventative maintenance procedures, often requiring on-call availability for emergencies; reporting to the property manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintenance Repairs:

*Perform basic carpentry repairs like door and cabinet replacements, drywall patching, and trim work.
*Address appliance malfunctions.

*Regularly inspect building systems including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and fire safety equipment.

Physical Ability:
Comfortable with manual labor, lifting heavy objects, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces.

title: EPDM Flat Roofing & Repair Specialist
body:
EPDM Flat Roofing & Repair Specialist
Kaufman Roofing | Twin Cities, MN
Full-Time | $25–$35/hour, based on experience
Kaufman Roofing is looking for an experienced EPDM flat roofing professional who takes pride in craftsmanship, knows how to solve problems, and is looking for a long-term career.
This isn't a large commercial production-roofing position.
Most of our flat roofing work consists of smaller residential roofs, additions, porches, repairs, and detailed low-slope applications. We're looking for someone who understands EPDM and knows that the details around walls, penetrations, transitions, edges and flashing are what make the difference between a roof that simply looks finished and one that stays watertight.
What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who:
• Has hands-on EPDM installation and repair experience
• Understands membrane installation, seams, flashing, terminations and waterproofing details
• Can diagnose leaks and troubleshoot unusual roof conditions
• Can look at a difficult detail and determine the right way to handle it
• Takes pride in clean, professional workmanship
• Pays attention to the small details
• Is dependable and comfortable working independently when needed
• Communicates professionally with coworkers, project managers and homeowners
• Wants a long-term career, not just another roofing job
Experience with TPO, other roofing systems or sheet metal is a plus, but not required.
What You'll Be Doing
• Installing EPDM rubber roofing systems on residential low-slope and flat roofs
• Completing detailed flashing work around walls, penetrations, transitions, chimneys and other roof details
• Diagnosing and repairing flat-roof leaks
• Handling smaller, detail-oriented projects rather than large commercial production roofs
• Working with our project managers and roofing crews to ensure every project meets Kaufman Roofing's quality standards
• Maintaining a clean, professional and safe jobsite
Pay & Benefits
• $25–$40/hour, based on experience
• Paid Time Off
• Health Insurance
• Dental Insurance
• 401(k)
• Company Phone
• Full-time employment with an established, family-owned company
• A work environment where quality and craftsmanship matter
• Opportunities to grow with the company
About Kaufman Roofing
Kaufman Roofing has been serving Twin Cities homeowners since 1930. We're a local, family-owned roofing company with a reputation built on quality workmanship, customer service and doing things the right way.
Our philosophy is simple: Quality Always. Educate – Not Sell. Details, Details, Details.
If you're an experienced flat roofer who's tired of being just another person on a large production crew and would rather work on projects where your skill, judgment and craftsmanship actually matter, we'd like to talk with you.
Apply today and tell us about your EPDM and flat-roofing experience.

title: CONSTRUCTION / LANDSCAPE FOREMAN
body:
High-End Shoreline Restoration Projects
We are looking for a proven field leader who can walk onto a complex jobsite, take control of a crew, operate equipment skillfully, solve problems independently, maintain high standards, and get projects completed efficiently and professionally.
This is a leadership position for someone who already knows how to run jobs.
Our company specializes in high-end shoreline restoration projects throughout Minnesota and surrounding states. Projects include grading, boulder placement, retaining walls, erosion control, excavation, riprap installation, drainage, concrete steps, heavy equipment operation, and complete lakefront transformations.
Why does this ad say “construction/landscape foreman”? Because there really is no common “shoreline restoration foreman” position in this industry. The closest fit is typically an experienced landscape or construction foreman who already understands grading, rock work, equipment operation, crew management, site logistics, and jobsite production.
That said, this is NOT a traditional landscaping position.
If your passion is spending every day installing paver patios, outdoor kitchens, decorative lighting, and sod projects, this may not be the right fit for you. While we do occasionally build patios, retaining walls, fire pits, and other landscape features, the majority of our work happens directly on the shoreline involving rock, dirt, geotextile fabric, grading, riprap, erosion control, and heavy equipment work.
This is not a clipboard foreman position. You will work alongside the crew while leading from the front.
What we’re looking for:
• 10+ years of serious landscape, excavation, or construction experience
• Current or recent foreman/superintendent experience
• Strong equipment skills, especially skid steers and mini excavators
• High standards for cleanliness, efficiency, organization, and workmanship
• Ability to manage crews firmly, professionally, and productively
• Ability to think independently and solve problems without constant supervision
• Someone physically capable of working hard alongside the crew
• Someone who values discipline, urgency, accountability, and professionalism
• Someone who lives within roughly 30 minutes of Forest Lake, MN
What matters to us:
• Jobs stay organized
• Equipment stays clean
• Crews stay productive
• Customers stay impressed
• Mistakes, damage, and laziness stay rare
This is a high-performance operation. We are not interested in constant smoke breaks, dragging jobs out, endless gas station stops, sloppy work, or excuse-making.
What we offer:
• Up to six-figure compensation for the right person
• Year-round employment
• Newer high-end trucks and equipment
• Significant autonomy and authority in the field
• Opportunity to help run and grow a specialized niche company (as well as a unique niche winter business)
• PTO and paid holidays
• No corporate nonsense
Important:
If you are currently a strong foreman but feel underutilized, underpaid, surrounded by weak workers, or tired of poorly run jobsites, this position may be exactly what you’ve been looking for.
If you are inexperienced, unreliable, constantly job-hopping, physically unable to keep up, or looking for a temporary stepping-stone job, this is not the position for you.
To apply, reply with:
• Your experience
• Current position
• Equipment experience
• Foreman/leadership background
• Why you’re considering leaving your current company
• Your general location
We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of field operations long-term, not just collect a paycheck.
P.S. If you have a serious interest in this position, please reply in your own words. Spelling and grammar perfection are not important to us. We’d rather hear directly from you than read another generic AI-generated response.
P.P.S. If you're comfortable doing so, please include both your phone number and email address.

title: Apprentice Carpenter
body:
We are a small, family, Design / Build remodeling company looking to bring on a new apprentice carpenter. Most of our work is in Minneapolis and near west suburbs and typically consists of new second floors, additions, kitchen remodels, etc. We have been in business over 20 years and all of our work is word-of-mouth...we don't advertise or market. All architecture and carpentry is done in house so that means you will get to learn a wide range of skills, including framing and structures, window and door setting, siding and exterior trim, and finish carpentry. 
For the most part, I don't need you to be a master carpenter to start, but some basic familiarity with carpentry and hand/power tools is required. I do need you to be dependable, hard working, and to take pride in doing things well...my brother and I can train the rest. Are you curious? Are you willing to ask questions when you don't know something? Can you problem solve? Does it matter to you if you do a good job, even when someone isn't watching you? Are you an interesting person? While we would like to hire someone sooner rather than later, we don't really NEED another guy. I want to find the right guy...someone we enjoy working with, who gets "it", and who can tolerate our jobsite musical choices. (Which can range from Colter Wall to Depeche Mode to Def Leppard on any given day.)
The job isn't always fun...somedays it's a lot of demo, hauling stuff to the dumpster, and setting up / taking down the jobsite. But somedays you will be cranking out cutlists, nailing off walls, helping to set / flash windows, or learning finish carpentry. The pay and expectations are fair, we have health benefits and PTO, and as a small company we can be pretty flexible with scheduling around your personal life. You need dependable transportation and need to be able to pass a background check...we are often working in homes while clients are still living there, and my trusting you is an absolute requirement.
You don't need to know for sure that you want to be a carpenter for the rest of your life, you just have to be a solid person and worker, and be ready to learn and contribute for however long you're here. If this sounds like a good fit for you, we can start with a phone interview and then decide whether to meet in person.

title: Painting Subs Wanted - Year-Round Work, Bigger Jobs, $2,500+ Avg Pay
body:
WE HAVE MORE PAINTING WORK THAN OUR CURRENT CREWS CAN COVER.
Cairn Painting Co. is adding 2 subcontractor crews in the Twin Cities metro area. We're looking for established painting businesses - your own crew, equipment, insurance and EIN - who want a full calendar of well-paying work without spending anything on marketing.
-------- THE WORK --------
We are not a seasonal outfit and we are not a discount outfit. Those two things are why our crews stay with us.
- Year-round, including winter. Exteriors May through October, interiors November through April. We build the winter interior schedule in the fall, so you know what's coming before the snow does.
- Bigger jobs. Typical job runs $3,000-$6,000 total. We don't take low-end work, which means fewer setups, fewer drives across the metro, and more days in a row on one property.
- We sell on quality, not price. Our customers didn't choose the cheapest bid, so the scope is real, the prep is funded, and the products are good.
- 2-4 jobs per week available now. Residential repaints, interior and exterior.
- Every job is sold, measured and priced before it reaches you. No bidding, no estimating, no chasing homeowners for a decision.
- You get a written work order before you start: scope, colors, products, sheens, prep requirements and access details.
-------- THE PAY --------
- 50% of the total job price, less the cost of paint if we supply it.
- A $5,000 job pays you $2,500. If we bought $400 of paint for it, you're paid $2,100.
- Supply the paint yourself and you keep the full 50%.
- Paid within 7 days of the final walkthrough and your invoice. Check or ACH to your business. We will always pay same day when possible.
- 1099. Take a job or pass on it. No hourly, no salary, no non-compete.
- The price is the price, on your first job and your fiftieth. We don't haggle and we don't lowball.
-------- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR --------
1. A registered business in good standing - LLC, S-corp, or sole proprietor with an EIN. W-9 before the first job.
2. $1,000,000 general liability insurance, with a certificate naming Cairn Painting Co. LLC as additional insured before your first job. If you don't carry GL yet, get it and then reach out - it runs most painting crews under $100 a month.
3. Workers' compensation coverage if you have employees.
4. Registered with the Minnesota Department of Labor and Industry (contractor registration).
5. Your own transportation, ladders, sprayer and prep gear.
6. Enough written and spoken English to read a work order and communicate clearly by text. Every job here is directed in writing.
7. At least two painters on the crew.
-------- HOW WE RUN JOBS --------
- Read the full work order before you start. If anything is unclear or doesn't match what you find on site, tell us before day one. Questions are welcome and they save everyone money.
- A short end-of-day text with photos on each active job.
- Calls and texts returned within two hours during business hours.
- If you're running late or can't make it, we hear it from you the night before or first thing that morning.
- We walk the punch list together at the end of every job, before you invoice.
- Workmanship callbacks are handled by the crew that did the work, within 48 hours.
- The details are the job: clean cut lines, full coverage, correct sheens, hardware off and back on, surfaces protected, and a clean site at the end of each day.
-------- WHAT WE OWE YOU --------
Everything above is what we expect. Here is what you can count on from us.
- Steady work through the winter. A good crew shouldn't have to lay people off in January.
- Payment within 7 days, every time. You shouldn't have to call anyone to get paid.
- If we mis-measured or underestimated the prep, that's ours. We adjust the price, not your pay.
- Once you accept a job, the number is locked. We don't re-trade and we don't shop your price.
- Nothing comes out of your check that wasn't in the work order.
- We handle the customer. If something comes up, we address it with them and then talk it through with you directly.
- The schedule comes to you ahead of time so you can plan your crew and your material buys.
- One point of contact, and they answer the phone.
- After a few jobs together you get first pick of the schedule and priority on the larger projects.
We're looking for a long relationship with two or three crews, not a rotating list of subs. When we find people who do this well, we keep them busy and we take care of them.
-------- HOW TO APPLY --------
Email us with this subject line:
SUB CREW - [Your Business Name]
Please answer these in the body, numbered, so we can move quickly:
1. Business name, city, and years in business.
2. How many painters are on your crew, and who would lead our jobs?
3. Do you carry general liability insurance? Carrier and limits.
4. Are you registered with Minnesota DLI? Registration number if so.
5. What sprayer do you own - make and model?
6. Three jobs you finished in the last 60 days: city, interior or exterior, and roughly what each was worth.
7. A work order calls for spraying the ceilings, but you'd rather roll them on this house. How do you handle that?
8. Walk us through your last day on a job, from the final coat to pulling out of the driveway.
9. A customer calls three days after you finish about holidays (thin or missed spots) on a dining room wall. What happens next?
10. Two references we can call, with names and phone numbers.
Please attach 3-5 photos of your own finished work. Phone photos are fine.
We read every complete reply. If it looks like a fit we'll call within 48 hours and walk a live job together, so you can see exactly what you'd be taking on before either of us commits.
Cairn Painting Co.
Serving Eden Prairie and the West Metro | Insured

title: Maintenance Technician - 140
body:
SCOPE:
A Maintenance Technician in property management is responsible for performing a variety of repairs and maintenance tasks across residential or commercial properties, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general upkeep, responding to resident/tenant service requests, and ensuring the overall functionality and appearance of the property by completing routine inspections and preventative maintenance procedures, often requiring on-call availability for emergencies; reporting to the property manager.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Maintenance Repairs:
*Diagnose and repair plumbing issues like leaky faucets, clogged drains, and toilet malfunctions.
*Troubleshoot and fix electrical problems including faulty outlets, lighting fixtures, and wiring.
*Service HVAC systems, addressing issues with heating, cooling, and air filtration.
*Perform basic carpentry repairs like door and cabinet replacements, drywall patching, and trim work.
*Address appliance malfunctions.
*Conduct minor painting and touch-up work.
Preventative Maintenance:
*Regularly inspect building systems including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and fire safety equipment. 
*Perform routine checks on exterior building components like windows, doors, and siding. 
*Maintain landscaping and grounds as needed. 
*Monitor and replace worn-out parts to prevent future breakdowns. 
Resident Service Requests:
*Promptly respond to resident maintenance requests and work orders. 
*Communicate effectively with residents regarding repair status and updates. 
*Prioritize urgent repairs and address emergency situations. 
Administrative Tasks:
*Maintain accurate records of work orders, repairs completed, and parts inventory. 
*Coordinate with contractors for larger projects requiring specialized skills. 
*Adhere to safety protocols and building codes. 
Emergency Repairs:
May require on-call availability for emergency repairs 
Vendor Management:
Coordinate with outside contractors for complex repairs, obtaining quotes and overseeing work completion.
Documentation:
Maintain detailed records of repairs, work orders, parts inventory, and inspection reports.
Safety Compliance:
Adhere to all safety regulations and procedures while performing maintenance tasks.
Other responsibilities deemed necessary by supervisor
QUALIFICATIONS:
Technical Skills:
Proficient knowledge of basic plumbing, electrical, HVAC systems, carpentry, and general maintenance practices. 
Problem-Solving:
Ability to diagnose issues, troubleshoot problems, and find effective solutions. 
Physical Ability:
Comfortable with manual labor, lifting heavy objects, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces. 
Customer Service:
Commitment to providing timely and quality service to residents. 
Time Management:
Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple work orders, and meet deadlines.
Valid Driver's License:
Reliable transportation to travel to and from properties.
Physical Requirements and work environment:
*Primarily working outdoors and indoors on various residential or commercial properties.
*Exposure to various weather conditions
*Ability to lift 50 100 lbs. following appropriate safety procedures
*Work in an upright standing position for extended periods of time
*Crawl in small and tight spaces
*Walk and climb stairs, handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; Reach with hands and arms; Communicate, receive and exchange ideas and information by means of the spoken and written word
*Ability to navigate the property/building quickly and easily as required to meet the job functions
*Ability to detect auditory and/or visual emergency alarms
*Specific responsibilities and requirements may vary depending on the size and type of property management company, as well as local regulations.

title: AUTOMOTIVE TECHNICIAN NEEDED
body:
This isn't your typical wanted ad. I'm looking for a true A technician. A tech that can handle his own bay. I do digital inspections, diagnostics, repairs and confirmations. That's 90% of what I ask. I don't need you to be perfect. I want you to be honest in your recommendations and I want you to be honest in your repairs. I'm looking for someone that can do the inspection, diagnostic, repair and confirm the fix. Unfortunately I'm not looking to hire a C tech that can't diag as much as they'd like at this time.
The AIR CONDITIONED shop is a relaxed atmosphere with good vibes, lots of laughter, bad/dad jokes fly freely, training sessions, great food etc. We are right on 75th and Lyndale Ave S. We are surrounded by many food places on the same block. Chipotle, Broadway Pizza, Sarpinoes, DQ, Potbelly's, Asain food and more literally on the same block or across the street. Right off 494 and 35W so travel there and back is easy. 
I'm open to pay what you are worth as long as you are efficient. If you claim to be worth $40 an hour but turn 25 hours, we will have to sit down again. If you want flat rate because you turn 50 hours weekly, I'm down for that. If you want hourly because you sit consistently at 35 billed hours weekly, let's do it. If you are turning 20 hours a week, I just can't afford that right now. Your benefits can be tailored to you. Whether you are into travel, racing, sports, collectables, opening your own shop, kids college, getting out of dept or whatever it may be, let's build something that gets you your "wants and whys". 
I'm into training and we travel all around the country for training, last one was SEMA/AAPEX in Vegas a couple months ago. Benn to VisionKC many times. Next one will probably be in WI at a smaller hands on oscilloscope training(really looking forward to that one). It's just me, another strong B(maybe A) tech and a C tech and it's pretty busy. I'm not perfect and learning a lot but I love this stuff and love the challenge of these cars coming in. I just moved to this location 2 years ago from my first spot of 5 years. I'm not the typical dusty old shop with fan belts and bikini posters hanging up, I'm a clean(ish) and dry shop with big doors and good heat. We spend decent on marketing and get good results. We have great reviews on Google and Carfax. I'm just looking for a great A tech that wants to grow

body:
Bona Bros. Automotive Services is hiring an experienced Automotive Technician for our Fridley shop.
For more than 70 years, Bona Bros. has provided trusted repair and maintenance for Twin Cities families, businesses, and fleets. Our Fridley location is a busy, well-equipped automotive facility servicing all makes and models of domestic and foreign cars, SUVs, pickups, and light-duty fleet vehicles.
If you enjoy real diagnostic and repair work, want the equipment, training, and team support to do the job right, we’d like to hear from you.
----------------------------------------
WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON
----------------------------------------
- All makes and models of domestic and foreign vehicles
- Cars, SUVs, pickups, and light-duty commercial/fleet vehicles
- Diagnostics using OEM and dealer-level scan tools and service information
- Engines, transmissions, electrical systems, fuel systems, drivetrains, suspension, steering, brakes, tires, and alignments
- Preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs ranging from routine to major

OPTIONAL OPPORTUNITIES TO EXPAND YOUR SKILLS

This is primarily an automotive and light-duty fleet role. Technicians interested in broadening their skills may also have opportunities to work on:
- Comcast bucket trucks and aerial lifts

- Railroad railgear equipment
- Smaller diesel applications
The right candidate may also have opportunities to work with or eventually join our New Brighton Truck & Utilities operation.

- Maintain a clean, safe, organized work area
- Continue building technical knowledge through company-paid training and industry education
- Collaborate with fellow technicians on difficult diagnostic or repair issues
----------------------------------------
QUALIFICATIONS
----------------------------------------
- At least 3 years of professional automotive diagnostic and repair experience preferred
- Strong ability to diagnose and repair a broad range of vehicle systems
- Comfortable working on both domestic and foreign makes
- Experience with OEM diagnostic tools and scan equipment preferred
- DOT Inspector certification preferred; we will send the right candidate to class

- Team-first attitude, good communication skills, and pride in quality work

BENEFITS

title: Antique White 77 Rotary Sewing Machine In Cabinet with Accessories
body:
It has been said that the White 77 Rotary Electric sewing machine was built for a lifetime of service. I believe this to be true. It still sews beautifully. 
It is a fairly simple, straightforward friction driven 65-watt machine. It was patented on October 25, 1927. The model number is 77-85086.
- Rotary Straight Stitch
-thread spool holders has "sleeves" allowing to be easier to rotate. 
- thread tension knob
- pressure foot adjustment knob
- forward and reverse stitch length knobs allowing for independent adjustments. 
- spring loaded bobbin winder
- release knob on wheel to wind the bobbin, so only the bobbin winds - not the needle.
- reverse lever
 - knee pedal
- light with off/on switch
The cabinet measurements:
29" high
17 1/2" wide
30 1/2" long when closed
63" long when open 
 Comes with numerous attachments, extra bobbins, manual and the Magic Key button hole worker

title: Benji Asada "Spring Bloom" and "Snow Covered Bamboo"
body:
Two original woodblock prints from by Benji Asada (1899-1984). Frame is 12 3/4" by 13 3/4" and contains both art pieces.
Asada's woodblock prints sold from the artelino site range from $50-240 each. From the artelino website:
Benji Asada: Biography
Benji Asada (1899–1984) was born in Kameoka, near Kyoto. He studied at the Kyoto City School of Fine Arts and Crafts and the Kyoto City Specialist School of Painting. One of his teachers was Goun Nishimura, a well-known Japanese painter.
Sosaku Hanga and Shin Hanga
In the 1920s and 1930s, Benji Asada participated in the sosaku hanga artists' circles in both Tokyo and Kyoto. While Tokyo artists often followed either the sosaku hanga approach or the shin hanga style promoted by the publisher Watanabe, Kyoto printmakers frequently worked across both methods.
Among the Kyoto artists, Tokuriki Tomikichiro was a close friend of Benji Asada. Tokuriki designed woodblock prints for Kyoto publishers such as Uchida, with the carving and printing completed by the publishers’ craftsmen. Although he also produced self-carved and self-printed sosaku hanga works, these were far less commercially successful than his shin hanga “artisan prints,” as he called them.
Published by Uchida
Benji Asada focused primarily on painting, but like Tokuriki Tomikichiro, he also produced both self-made prints and designs published as “artisan prints” by Uchida in the 1950s. Compared to Tokuriki, Asada’s output of print designs was relatively small.
Woodblock Prints by Benji Asada
Woodblock prints by Benji Asada remain relatively affordable. Kyoto artists who worked in both the shin hanga and sosaku hanga traditions have received limited attention in the art market. There may still be many undiscovered designs in the archives of major Kyoto publishers such as Uchida or Unsodo.

title: Montague Dawson - Gale Force Eight
body:
This is a stunning, beautifully framed vintage open-edition lithograph of "Gale Force Eight" by the legendary 20th-century British maritime artist Montague Dawson.
This captivating piece perfectly captures the raw power of the ocean, showing a tall ship's crew battling intense wind and massive waves on a dramatically tilted deck. It is a quintessential masterpiece of nautical art that brings immediate character, history, and adventure to any office, study, living room, or coastal home.
This piece is a genuine vintage release published in 1974 by Venture Prints Limited of Bristol, England. The original publisher’s information strip and title credits were meticulously saved during the framing process and remain permanently attached to the paper dust cover on the back as proof of its 1974 heritage.
Housed in a deep-profile dark wood frame that perfectly complements the rich blues and wood tones of the painting. Excellent vintage condition. The colors remain rich and vivid, the glass is clean, with minimal age-appropriate wear.
