title: Walter Tyndale - Brading, Isle of Wight
body:
This beautifully framed piece is an antique reproduction print by the prominent British topographical watercolorist Walter Frederick Roofe Tyndale. The painting captures an idyllic, rural scene depicting a young country woman tending to a flock of white geese outside a rustic, timber-framed stone cottage.
This is an authentic solid wood frame (likely oak or ash), distinguishable by the continuous, flowing grain pattern along the perimeter.
It features an internal cream-colored oval mat board that provides a clean, neutral border, focusing the eye on Walter Tyndale’s watercolor composition.

title: Andrew Wyeth - Wolf Rivers
body: While sitting down to write a letter to his son Nicholas, Wyeth noticed a basket of decoration-grade apples catching the afternoon autumn light. He immediately sketched a quick watercolor on his letterhead, abandoned the letter, and headed straight to his studio to paint the final composition. The stark, moody composition highlights a woven basket brimming with red apples resting next to a carved wooden Canada goose decoy atop a dark antique wooden cabinet. If your print features a sticker or stamp mentioning "Marlin Art" (often misspelled as Marlan Art), it means this piece was framed and sold through Marlin Art, a famous New York-based fundraising art auction company. (labeled on the back). The code WYET00316 is the specific Marlin Art gallery inventory SKU catalog number assigned to Andrew Wyeth Wolf Rivers print. title: Marcel Julian Baron Signed Art Prints
body:
Very good shape and signed in pencil. 
Someone has these online for 149 a piece and says they are colored in prints. 
I'm not sure but I think it's just prints and not colored in but I could be wrong
These 2 prints are roughly 13" x 10 1/2 Framed.
 The frames have chips and parts of the paint missing.
They have little red spots throughout the print. Not sure what it is but not noticeable till you get up close.
Here is what the person online said that sold theirs on etsy:
About this item
Did you ever have an art piece that you liked so much that you will never lower the price so that it will stay around as long as possible? Just me? Well okay then....this is the one.
A charming ink on color of people in a square with a 1930's era car in the center and a tower with three statues on the top in the distance. I am guessing Paris since that was the place Marcel Julien Baron did so much of his work.
This print is signed on the bottom right corner in pencil "Baron."
It was purchased at auction is not verified as authentic so please see the photo before purchase.
My language on technique may not be accurate so please go with the details I am putting below.
The edge is very defined so before I removed it from the frame I thought it was a print.
The ink portion of the drawing is raised and textured which leads me to believe that this is an original work. The coloring is flat, under the ink. It looks like he did an ink drawing over a lithograph or aquatint (this is where my knowledge of technique gets murky).
The color part has a very defined border but the ink passed the lines in spots on the bottom.
The 6 12" X 9" artwork is done on board.

title: Adolph Sehring - A Day At The Beach
body:
A classic 1975 lithograph depicting a coastal scene featuring a young boy walking along a sandy path through sea oats and dunes toward the ocean, accompanied by flying seagulls.
A deep "scoop" or "cove" shape that curves inward, drawing the eye toward the center of the artwork. It is a rich, dark brown oak or walnut stain with heavily visible wood grain and charred/distressed accents along the edges to give it a weathered appearance. The frame size is 14 x 17.

title: Jerome B. Thompson  - Apple Gathering
body:
Bring a touch of timeless, cozy Americana charm into your home with this beautiful vintage reproduction of Jerome Thompson’s famous 1856 oil painting, "Apple Gathering" (also known as Apple Picking). This is a classic mid-20th-century (circa 1940s–1960s) lithograph print. It features a unique factory-textured finish designed to mimic the tactile look and feel of an authentic oil painting canvas. The artwork beautifully depicts an idealized, romanticized harvest scene of rural life—perfect for farmhouse, cottage, or traditional rustic interior design styles. It comes housed in its original, heavy, wide solid wood frame which boasts a lovely natural grain and a warm, aged patina.
Frame size is 20 x 28.

title: Norman Rockwell - Spring Flowers
body: This is a vintage 1969 Norman Rockwell lithograph titled "Spring Flowers" in a rustic wood frame. This print is famously recognized as one of the very few still-life paintings created by Norman Rockwell, completely devoid of human subjects. The scene depicts the gardening tools and accessories belonging to his third wife, Molly, including her sun hat, sneakers, garden gloves, and a vibrant basket of flowers. It was painted during the winter months using florist-bought flowers and published in McCall's magazine in 1969. Frame size is 19 x 23.

title: Bonnie L. Mohr - Renew
body:
This is a beautiful, authentic "Renew" framed art print by renowned rural artist Bonnie L. Mohr. This piece features a peaceful shoreline scene with a rowboat, overlaid with Mohr’s deeply moving inspirational poem about self-reclamation, rest, and peace.
Features a thick, rustic barnwood-style frame. Excellent pre-owned condition. Clean surface, no warping or damage to the print, and the frame is sturdy. Perfect for a living room, cabin, lake house, or bedroom decor. Frame size is 19.5 x 23.5. Ready to hang.

title: Otto J. Schneider signed - Print of 1909 Etching - Napoleon Bonaparte
body:
Signed print (faux vellum/parchment) of a 1909 etching of Napoleon Bonaparte by Otto J. Schneider (1875-1946) based on a work by Paul Delaroche (1797-1856) in 1840 (Oil on Canvas)
Barmore Publishing Company (Publisher)
Otto J. Schneider:
Painter. Born in Muscatine, IA on Aug. 8, 1865. At age 15 Schneider became a pupil of Vanderpoel and Grover at the AIC. Moving to Buffalo, NY, he continued his studies at the local ASL and at the ASL in NYC followed by work in Paris at Académie Julian. 
Schneider taught at the Buffalo ASL for two years before moving to San Diego in 1926. In that year he joined the staff at the San Diego Academy of Fine Arts and taught there until his death on Jan. 23, 1950. 
Early in his career he painted Dutch and French scenes; later his palette brightened as he turned to Impressionism; while during his last years he used a bold, vigorous brush stroke. 
Member: Assoc. Artists of San Diego, 1929 (co-founder); Contemporary Artists of San Diego. Exh: Paris Salon
Dimensions:
21-1/2" W x 26-5/8" H

title: Steve Bloom serigraph "Parkside", signed and numbered
body:
New Steve Bloom hand signed and numbered serigraph "Parkside." #150 of 325. Never framed, measures 25 x 37 plus full borders. 
Can pick up in Victoria.
ABOUT THE ARTIST:
Artist Steve Bloom has the unique ability to combine his mastery of the most  ancient printmaking techniques with the most contemporary processes to create his internationally renowned imagery. As with most artists Bloom is never content to work in one medium and has been exploring traditional painting techniques as well as his print making and digital imaging.
Bloom received his B.A. in Art with an emphasis in illustration from California State Fullerton. During graduate studies Steve was hired to produce his limited edition etchings and serigraphs for an international art distribution company. Within six months, he had designed and set up a premier in-house printmaking studio. With the créme de la créme  of resources and supplies at his disposal, Bloom produced editions that are collected all over the world.
“Working with renowned master printmakers and famous artists gave me experience that is Priceless”. For example, speaking with Salvador Dali’s atelier manager regarding embossing processes or discussing a ‘secret’ formula used by Picasso’s Atelier for copper plate etching, were very exciting moments for me. Creating a serigraph for/with David Hockney in the late 80’s also stands out as a high point in my professional career”.
Years of professional experience has truly made Bloom a master chromist who understands color and its relationship to printing and painting. A true pioneer of the digital art movement Steve was early on one of the few to have his digital creations hanging in galleries. His stylized imagery reflects the emotion and movement he experiences in his appreciation of the musical and performing arts.
Bloom recently received an award sponsored by the National Endowment for the Arts for the city of Reno, Nevada. Also know for his coin designs for the Masters Golf Tournament, Bitcoin and NFL game coins to name a few of his hundreds of designs.
Golf imagery: Bloom’s paintings hang in numerous country clubs and he is the tournament artist for several charity golf tournaments creating signature hole images for the courses as well as mural sized oils for their clients.

title: Wyland ORIGINAL Watercolor Painting of Dolphin w/ COA & Paperwork
body:
Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of the ocean with this original watercolor painting by world-renowned marine life artist Robert Wyland. Titled "Dolphin XVIII," this captivating piece features a dolphin gracefully navigating a vibrant, deep blue underwater seascape. Known for his monumental whaling walls and dedication to marine conservation, Wyland’s original watercolors are highly sought after by collectors.
The painting highlights his signature fluid style, utilizing rich washes of blue to create a sense of depth and movement. It is beautifully presented in a classic black frame with a complementary light, textured matting that features a floating mount to showcase the natural deckled edge of the watercolor paper.
Key Details:
Artist: Robert Wyland
Title: Dolphin XVIII
Medium: Original Watercolor
Signature: Hand-signed by the artist in the lower right corner.
Framing: Professionally framed and matted (framed as shown during the original fine art auction).
Provenance:
This piece comes with excellent provenance. Included with the purchase is a copy of the original invoice from Princess Cruises Fine Arts. The document confirms it was acquired at an art auction aboard the Island Princess on February 14, 2005. The original purchase price, including the buyer's premium, was $3,795.00 (Total with shipping: $3,830.00).
Also included is an email I received from the Director of the Wyland Gallery in Key West confirming the authenticity of this painting.
Condition:
The artwork and frame are in excellent condition. The painting has been carefully preserved behind glass/acrylic. Please review the provided photos carefully for a full view of the frame and artwork quality.
What’s Included:
Original framed "Dolphin XVIII" watercolor painting.
Copy of the original Princess Cruises Fine Arts invoice (dated 02/14/2005) and authenticity email from the Wyland Gallery.

title: Toyota Digital Sales Performance Manager
body:
Apply Now Digital Sales Performance Manager – Walser Toyota 
 Where Sales, Technology & Performance Come Together 
 Are you the person who sees opportunity in the data? Who knows how to turn a lead into an appointment, a database into a sales pipeline, and a CRM into a true performance tool? 
 Walser Toyota Bloomington is looking for a Digital Sales Performance Manager to help drive results across one of Walser Automotive Group’s largest and highest-volume operations. 
 This is more than managing leads or running reports. You’ll sit at the intersection of sales, technology, data, process, and people —partnering directly with dealership leadership to identify opportunities, improve conversion, coach performance, and generate incremental business. 
 And you’ll do it at an operation with serious scale. 
 Why Walser Toyota Bloomington? 
 The performance—and recognition—speak for themselves: 
 7,000+ vehicles sold annually for the past 7 consecutive years 
 Toyota Board of Governors Award Winner – 3 consecutive years (2023, 2024 & 2025) 
 President’s Award for Customer First – 7 consecutive years 
 Customer First Advisory Board Winner – recognizing the Top 50 Toyota dealerships nationally for excellence in service, parts, and customer satisfaction 
 World-class, state-of-the-art facility 
 Prime Bloomington location in the center of the Twin Cities 
 At this volume, digital performance matters. 
 You’ll have the opportunity to influence thousands of customer interactions, maximize a robust customer database, improve lead conversion, uncover sales and acquisition opportunities, and help our sales team perform at an even higher level. 
 Compensation: On-Target Earnings of $75,000 with earning potential of $100,000+ 
 Performance-based incentive opportunity gives you the ability to directly impact your earning potential through results. 
 Who This Role Is Perfect For 
 This role is built for someone who loves the combination of sales, technology, analytics, process, and coaching. 
 You may be a: 
 Digital Sales or BDC leader ready for a larger platform 
 Automotive sales professional who excels with CRM, lead management, and follow-up 
 Sales Team Lead or Assistant Manager who loves coaching performance 
 CRM or database power user who knows how to turn customer data into opportunities 
 Results-driven sales professional who is naturally analytical, tech-savvy, and process-oriented 
 If you’re someone who looks at a sales funnel and immediately starts thinking about response time, follow-up, appointments, conversion, lost opportunities, and what we could do better , we want to meet you. 
 What You’ll Do 
 As our Digital Sales Performance Manager, you’ll help connect customer data, digital opportunities, technology, and sales execution to drive measurable dealership performance. 
 Drive Digital Sales Performance 
 Establish and continuously improve best practices for digital lead handling 
 Monitor incoming digital opportunities and ensure leads are distributed equitably and acted on quickly 
 Identify gaps in response, follow-up, appointment setting, and conversion 
 Adapt digital sales strategies as customer behavior and business needs evolve 
 Drive incremental sales, service, and vehicle acquisition opportunities through proactive outreach 
 Own the Technology & Data 
 Serve as an expert user of DriveCentric CRM and AutoAlert 
 Manage CRM business rules, plans, lead sources, system maintenance, and user management 
 Manage monthly and ad hoc database and equity-mining campaigns 
 Leverage customer and vehicle data to uncover new sales and acquisition opportunities 
 Create and manage daily, weekly, and monthly reporting across key performance metrics 
 Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations for dealership leadership 
 Coach & Elevate Performance 
 Partner closely with the General Manager and Sales Managers to identify performance opportunities across the sales team 
 Coach Customer Specialists on lead management, follow-up, work plans, and digital sales best practices 
 Identify underperformance through data and help create actionable improvement plans 
 Assist managers and sales staff with work plans to ensure quality, consistency, and completion 
 Create accountability around digital opportunities from initial customer inquiry through appointment and sale 
 Build Business From Our Existing Customers 
 Implement and manage a daily service-to-sales process 
 Develop database campaigns designed to re-engage existing and unsold customers 
 Use equity-mining technology to identify customers with potential upgrade, trade, or acquisition opportunities 
 Partner across Sales and Service to turn customer relationships into incremental opportunities 
 What You Bring 
 Proven success in sales, digital sales, CRM management, lead management, or data-driven performance 
 Automotive dealership experience strongly preferred 
 Strong sales and customer service instincts 
 Confidence working with technology, CRM platforms, reporting, and performance data 
 Ability to analyze metrics and turn insights into action 
 Strong coaching, influencing, and relationship-building skills 
 Excellent verbal and written communication 
 High level of organization, accountability, and attention to detail 
 Ability to adapt quickly as technology, customer behavior, and business needs change 
 Professional, positive, solutions-oriented approach 
 Must be at least 18 years of age 
 Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record 
 What’s In It For You? 
 Paid Time Off (PTO) – Take time to relax, spend with family, or enjoy personal time away 
 Career Growth & Opportunity for Advancement We promote from within and provide clear career paths, mentorship, and opportunities to develop and grow your career. 
 Fertility & Adoption Assistance: Receive up to $10,000 in financial assistance for fertility treatments and adoption expenses. 
 Comprehensive Health Benefits: Enjoy medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus access to HSA and FSA plans to help manage healthcare costs. Access to Blue Cross Blue Shield medical coverage and access to additional wellness benefits. 
 Life Insurance & 401(k) with Employer Match: Plan for your future with company-paid life insurance and a 401(k) program that includes an employer match. 
 Paid Clothing Program: Twice a year, choose from a hand-curated collection of branded Walser apparel—on us. 
 Employee Discounts: Enjoy exclusive employee discounts across products and services. 
 Employee Resource Groups: Connect, learn, and grow with our inclusive Employee Resource Groups, including Women of Walser, Drive with Pride, Asian Hmong Alliance, and Veterans at Walser. 
 Community Involvement Make an impact through volunteer opportunities with the Walser Foundation, supporting local causes and giving back to the communities we serve. 
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Support for personal and professional challenges 
 Referral Program – Earn referral bonuses for referring talented candidates 
 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. 
 Walser Automotive Group is an EOE/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ+ employer. Apply Now
